items.description: The sculptures of 2D and 3D Concept Artist Arsen Asyrankulov must be seen to be believed. In this brand new upcoming Organic Sculpting course, Arsen not only shares his method for producing poetic forms but also his comprehensive workflow so you can realize your own imaginations.

Learn the fundamentals of painting realistic portraits from industry-leading artist Daniel Walsh. Utilizing the advanced techniques learned throughout his career, Daniel will show you his process for crafting eye-catching portraits for characters. By starting off with the very basics of sketching and deconstructing an image using the Bargue Method, you'll learn everything necessary to create beautiful final paintings to add your portfolio.

Dive into the transformative world of costume design with Adam Middleton, a visionary behind some of cinema's most unforgettable outfits. In this hands-on course, you'll master the art of weaving narrative depth and realistic detail into every aspect of your costume designs. Whether you're a beginner just getting started or a professional refining your skills, Adam's techniques will elevate your costume designs to an expert level of lived-in authenticity. Prepare to unleash your creativity and bring characters to life through the art of grounded costume design.

Find out exactly what it takes to go freelance and make a living from your artwork. In this comprehensive course from celebrated illustrator Tran Nguyen, you'll learn her process for sketching, coloring, composition, working with clients, and digitizing your artwork for delivery. By following Tran's guidance, not only will you have a beautiful portfolio piece of your own, but you'll have the necessary knowledge to get hired for jobs, win clients, and wow your peers.

Design stunning creatures for films and video games under the guidance of professional artist Milan Nikolic. You'll start by studying the anatomy of bipeds and multipeds, learn the ins and outs of sculpting in ZBrush and 3D Coat, and finally how to pose, texture, and present your creatures with polish and professionalism.

Unleash the worlds within you. Under the guidance of acclaimed illustrator KleinerHai, sketching will become so much more than just lines on paper - it will become your bridge to endless possibilities. You'll learn to sketch everything from monumental landscapes down to intricate life details, crafting universes with every stroke. Inspiration isn’t something you wait for; it’s something you wield. A new world is only a few sketches away.

Characters are the heart and soul of any movie, comic or video game. In this Course, illustrator Philipp Kruse shares his secrets to populating projects with compelling humanoid designs. Strap in for an interactive tour all the way from artistic first principles to the most advanced tricks, each tailored to make your characters not only look amazing, but feel like living, breathing parts of their worlds. With these new techniques, you'll be creating beautiful work to showcase your unique skills in ways you never thought possible before.

If you've ever felt overwhelmed by ZBrush, you've come to the right place. Follow along as concept artist Alex Figini takes you through his entire process for creating complex characters and props for films and games. Covering everything from basic principles to advanced sculpting techniques, this course is a robust toolkit for concepting with ZBrush, Marvelous Designer, and Keyshot.
From loose sketch to realistic rendered illustration, create futuristic character design with consistency and speed. Tackle difficult subject matter with different concepting techniques.

Embark on your journey into 3D art by learning the basics of ZBrush from one of the industry's leading concept artists, Pablo Dominguez. Designed for absolute beginners, this course covers the essentials of ZBrush's interface, tools, and sculpting processes, making it accessible and engaging to achieve any artist goals you may have. With interactive challenges and homework assignments built to reinforce your learning, this course will guide you to create bite-sized projects using your newly acquired skills.

Create eye-popping illustrations and dynamic compositions with clear shapes, decisive lines, and big poses. Learn from renowned artist Amin Faramarzian, whose high-contrast, high-energy pieces might look like Saturday morning cartoons on the surface, but often hide deeper and powerful themes underneath.

In this course, Senior Character Artist Antonio Esparza unveils his full 3D character art pipeline, guiding you from concept to production-ready results. You’ll learn industry techniques for sculpting, texturing, and refining characters used in games, films, and cinematics. Ideal for artists aiming to create high-quality characters, this course covers every essential step in Antonio’s process, equipping you with skills to elevate your portfolio.

Learn professional workflows to design characters for films, games, TV shows, and more from renowned concept designer and illustrator Wouter Gort. Covering everything from the fundamentals of character design, prop development, keyframe illustration, and more, this course covers everything you'll need to know to level up your character workflow.

Create 3D worlds to share with creative directors, tell more dynamic stories, and streamline your creative process. Industry professional Nick Hiatt covers his entire process in Maya, Substance, Redshift, and Photoshop, but the techniques in this training are not software dependent. Learn to use whichever tools you're most familiar with to create unique characters, detailed environments to place them in, and how to arrange everything into a dynamic, cohesive sequence.

Professional concept artist Louis Laurent's completely fluid process will help to unlock entirely new possibilities in your art. Using a mix of 2D and 3D techniques, you'll learn how to harness happy accidents along the way to create beautiful and unique works of art.

Don't just draft your visions - bring them to life. Under acclaimed illustrator KleinerHai's expert guidance, you'll learn to turn your sketches into captivating concept paintings and illustrations. Covering characters, creatures, buildings, props, environments, and everything in between, this course will teach you to paint every corner of your imagined world. Every brushstroke you create will add depth, narrative, and wonder to your creative vision.

The hotly anticipated conclusion to Louis Laurent's groundbreaking first course is here to help you rethink the way you approach your process for creating concept art. Learn to truly embrace the creative process and create beautiful works of art with uninhibited flow.

In this course, you’ll learn about the standards in place to guide designers in creating experiences that are accessible to all users as well as techniques to help bring your projects up to those standards.

In this course, we're going to learn the basics of CSS, one of the core technologies for designing and building websites and applications. No matter what kind of website or web application you want to build, you'll have to use CSS. If you haven't written much CSS, or even if you’ve never written CSS at all, don’t worry. That's what this course is for. We’ll start with basic CSS concepts, then gradually progress to more advanced topics and lessons.

In this short course, we're going to go beyond the basic selector concepts covered in CSS Basics. Besides the common ways to select elements with type, ID and class selectors, we're able to target elements based on their attributes, position in the HTML document, even their relation to other elements. By the end of this course, you'll have gained a better understanding of the power and flexibility behind CSS selectors. You'll have a new set of valuable tools in your CSS toolkit to use on your next project.

Typography is one of the most important aspects of good design. In this course, you'll learn all you need to know about creating good typography as a UX Designer: how to choose a typeface; what to look for when laying out type, how to create typographic hierarchy, laying out type, and creating responsive typography.

Flexbox is a set of CSS properties that give you a flexible way to lay out content. With flexbox you can change the direction, alignment, size and order of elements, regardless of their original size and order in the HTML. You can even stretch and shrink elements and distribute space, all with just a few lines of CSS!
For this practice session, Improve the layout of an existing mobile iOS app.

items.human_name: Handling Feedback as a UX Designer
items.description: This workshop prepares new designers for handling feedback on their work in a diplomatic, effective, and professional manner.

Responsive web design is a collection of techniques for building websites that work on multiple screen sizes. In these lessons, we're going to use the foundational principles of responsive design as a framework for thinking about page layout. By the end, you should have a better understanding of how to approach common decisions in responsive design.

Join us as we learn the basic principles of User Experience Design and how it shapes everyday interactions with products. By structuring products around users’ needs, we can ensure that the products do their job. You will learn how to meet users where they are, think through intuitive experiences, and create products that more effectively meet both your goals and your end users’ goals. This course will help you think more critically through the steps and decisions a user makes while interacting with your product. If you’re considering a career in User Experience (UX) or want to learn more abou

Collecting design inspiration is a fun way to get fresh ideas! It also helps you stay current with design trends and become aware of emerging design patterns. The goal is to collect designs that spark your own creative ideas.
Learn how a scalable, repeatable design system leads to a more efficient design. Learn the components of a design system, and how to work with existing documentation.

SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) also supports interactivity and animation, so you can animate and interact with SVG like you're able to do with HTML. This short course covers the most common methods for animating SVG: CSS transitions, transforms, and keyframe animations.

Learn how mockups are used in the design process, and discover techniques for bringing them into your workflow. Practice transforming a set of wireframes into realistic depictions of the app by applying visual design styling and using Apple’s UI Kit for Adobe XD.
Improve the typography on an existing design.

Learn the user-centered methods and mindsets that entire businesses are using to improve their product experiences. Throughout this course, we’ll go over how to find the voice of our user, the importance of that voice, and how to create a better experience for our user.

In this course, we're going to learn CSS properties for enhancing visual design. We’ll cover various properties for styling text, including loading web fonts from external resources. We’ll learn techniques for turning our CSS boxes into more than just rectangles. And finally, we’ll learn some really cool visual effects using CSS filters and gradients.

Learn how to effectively present your design process to stakeholders so you can communicate a vision. Define the agenda, set the project goals, share your research, compare iterations, navigate feedback, and create a path for the next steps.

Learn HTML (HyperText Markup Language), the language common to every website. HTML describes the basic structure and content of a web page. If you want to build a website or web application, you'll need to know HTML.

In this course, we're going to learn techniques for better control over our CSS layouts. We’ll cover how the CSS Box Model impacts the presentation of each HTML element, learn to control the position of each element onscreen, and even begin to adjust our layouts for different screen sizes and environments.

The web is a two-way communication medium. There are lots of HTML elements for displaying data and producing output, and conversely, there are also lots of HTML elements for accepting input. Accepting input from the user means creating web forms. In this course, we’ll learn about all the most important form elements that web professionals use on a daily basis.

Wireframing is a useful part of the design process. Throughout a website or mobile app project, you will have a lot of ideas and the best way to sort through those ideas is to brainstorm. Wireframes are a visual artifact of brainstorming, and the goal is to make them with minimal effort, as to encourage ideation. Whether you're a designer or not, wireframing is an important skill to have in your toolkit. It's beneficial for product managers, marketers, or anyone else with ideas for a website or mobile app. Wireframes are a valuable tool for visualizing user experiences, iterating on ideas, and

The web is filled with text and images, but it's also filled with information like sports scores throughout the years, lists of employee names and email addresses, or nutrition facts for your favorite foods. HTML tables enable the display information in what is commonly known as tabular data, which is information that's stored in a table-like structure of columns and rows. In general, anything that you might put into a spreadsheet could go in a table. There are many use cases for a table, so it's important to add them to your skills because it's a very common method for displaying information.

An essential part of the UX design process is measurement and validation. This course will provide an overview of the methods available for measuring the success of a design including A/B testing, surveys, and usability testing. It will specifically deep dive into usability testing so that students will learn about what’s involved in running such a test, from preparing a test plan to presenting actionable findings.

Going from a blank screen to a finished website can be daunting. In this course, you'll learn about the major steps involved in designing websites. We'll learn how to gather information, explore potential concepts, and iterate on a design. By the end, you'll have the foundation you need to continue your design journey.

Get started creating web pages with HTML and CSS, the basic building blocks of web development. HTML, or HyperText Markup Language, is a standard set of tags you will use to tell the web browser how the content of your web pages and applications are structured. Use CSS, or Cascading Style Sheets, to select HTML tags and tell the browser what your content should look like. Whether you are coding for fun or planning to start a career in web development, learning HTML and CSS is a great place to start.

Meet a UI builder that allows you to design with live code, but visually! UXPin Merge is a design tool for developers and technical designers who want 100% parity between design and code. Either you have code components and want to build a nicer UI, or you want to design with open-source libraries such as MUI, Bootstrap, or Tailwind UI — we've got you. In this workshop, we'll show you how to get the most out of coded components in design. Assemble functional prototypes and export clean code to ship products faster than ever.

For this practice session, you’ll be creating eight rough sketches for the primary screen of a sketching application. This app gives users the ability to make quick, shareable, black-and-white sketches using their fingers on a touchscreen.

CSS Grid Layout provides a built-in, more efficient way of designing grid-based layouts in the browser. It brings a new set of properties, functions and flexible units that let you control the exact placement and sizing of grid components.

CSS transitions and transforms can create simple animations that enhance user interactions in websites and apps. In this course, you'll build an interactive image gallery using CSS transitions and transforms. You'll use transition properties to define durations, delays, and easing functions. Then, you'll learn how to rotate, scale, and move elements in 2D and 3D space, with CSS transforms.

In this course, you'll get hands-on practice using CSS layout techniques such as a CSS Reset with Normalize, a layout wrapper, a sticky footer, and centered content with a full-width header. In addition, you'll learn principles that will help you approach your next project with a mobile-first mindset.
For this practice session, practice designing with color.

Sass is a stylesheet language that extends CSS with features like variables, nested rules, mixins, and functions, in a CSS-compatible syntax. In this course, you'll learn to use the powers of Sass to boost your front end workflow. The examples will teach you why you should use Sass in your projects. By the end, you will be writing more efficient CSS using code that is easy to read and maintain.
See positive ways of handling different types of feedback on your designs, including constructive, negative, and prescriptive feedback.

Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) is an XML markup language for creating two-dimensional images using vectors. This is different from traditional raster-based image formats that use pixels, like JPEG and PNG. When used on web pages, SVG images provide an infinite level of detail, so they look sharp regardless of screen size or pixel density. In this course, we'll look at situations where SVGs are better than PNG and JPEG files, as well as when an SVG might not be the best choice. Finally, we'll learn how to modify SVGs using CSS.

Learn how to build interactive and sharable prototypes in Figma, a web-based visual prototyping tool. You'll create a prototype for a "prosumer" mobile photography app, and by the end, you'll have a better understanding of how to create interactive prototypes that can be shared with project stakeholders and team members.
Learn to build with Bootstrap, one of the most popular open source front end frameworks, to help you build a functional design and layout in little time.

In this course, you'll build your design vocabulary and learn how to describe the basic building blocks of any visual image. We'll start by learning about the elements of design, like line, shape, and form. Then we'll move on to the principles of design, like balance, harmony, and movement. By the end, you'll have a better foundation for discussing design with other team members and you'll be able to make objective observations about what is often subjective subject matter.

items.human_name: Mastering Voiceovers with Audacity: Recording and Editing Essentials
items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to record and edit voiceovers in Audacity for professional results. You’ll learn to optimize recording settings, clean up mistakes, and apply effects like EQ, noise reduction, and compression. The course is suitable for content creators, podcasters, and video editors aiming to improve their audio production. With step-by-step guidance, this course is perfect for beginners and intermediates looking to enhance voiceovers using free software.

This tutorial explores fundamental sound generation and synthesis techniques using MSP in Max. Through 23 videos, you’ll learn to build synthesis patches, design GUIs, create LFOs, and transform MSP patches into standalone devices. The course is ideal for intermediate Max users aiming to develop audio DSP and synthesis skills. Key topics include working with oscillators, filters, modulation routing, and integrating GUI designs. Led by Phelan Kane, it offers practical knowledge for both music and multimedia projects.

items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to program and record drums in Ableton Live 12, covering everything from basic setup to advanced techniques for creating professional drum tracks. Whether you’re a beginner or an intermediate user, you’ll learn essential skills like configuring audio settings, navigating Session and Arrangement Views, creating and editing MIDI clips, building custom drum racks, and applying humanization techniques for realistic drum patterns. items.human_name: Recording and Editing Vocals in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to record and edit vocals in Ableton Live. The session covers setting up your audio interface and microphone, configuring latency settings, and managing take lanes for comping multiple vocal recordings. Anna also guides through editing techniques, including applying fades, organizing takes, and creating artificial harmonies using duplicated and transposed vocal tracks. The tutorial concludes with tips for mixing harmonies and using effects to enhance the final sound.

items.human_name: Recording Bass Guitar with Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to record and mix bass guitar using Ableton Live Lite. You’ll learn to set up an audio interface, apply amp simulations with GK Amplification and Amplitube 5, and use techniques like compression, sidechain compression, and time correction for a clean mix. Led by Arthur Carneiro, it’s ideal for musicians new to recording or those looking to enhance their bass mixing skills using Live Lite and VST plugins. The course covers everything from recording to finalizing tracks for a professional result.

items.human_name: Writing Harmonies and Melodies in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to sequence harmonies and melodies in Ableton Live. The session covers setting up MIDI tracks, selecting instruments like Simpler, and using features like the scale tool to ensure notes stay in key. Anna shows techniques for recording chords, adjusting basslines, adding an arpeggiator, and creating variations in the melody. The tutorial emphasizes creative recycling of clips, layering, and utilizing Arrangement View for a polished final arrangement.

items.human_name: Recording Audio from Youtube in Audacity
items.description: This tutorial guides you on how to record audio from YouTube using Audacity. It covers the process of setting up Audacity to capture system sound, configuring your recording settings, and editing the captured audio. The tutorial is ideal for those who want to record and manipulate audio for personal projects. It is accessible for users at all levels, providing a step-by-step walkthrough to ensure high-quality audio recordings from online sources.

items.human_name: Understanding Indian rhythm through simple algorithms
items.description: This tutorial explores South Indian Carnatic rhythms and their application in music production using algorithms. You’ll learn to recite simple konnakol phrases, create rhythmic algorithms, and translate them into Max patches. The course covers key Carnatic concepts like Tala, Jhati, and Nadai. Led by Dom Aversano, it’s designed for those interested in combining traditional Indian rhythms with computer music. Perfect for beginners exploring algorithmic rhythm creation and cross-cultural music techniques.

This masterclass teaches electronic musicians how to write for the violin and integrate orchestral instruments in their compositions. It covers standard violin articulations, realistic VST programming using tools like Spitfire's BBC Symphony Orchestra and SWAM's Violin, and best practices for writing idiomatic violin music. The course is ideal for composers, arrangers, and producers who want to achieve realistic string sounds in their projects. Led by Helen Noir, the course combines technical violin knowledge with practical music production tips.

items.human_name: Recording Acoustic Guitar Using Ableton Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial covers recording acoustic guitar using Ableton Live Lite. You'll learn how to set up your audio interface and microphone, record and edit guitar tracks, and apply effects like EQ and compression. It is suitable for beginners and intermediate users looking to improve their recording techniques. Topics include configuring inputs, microphone placement, time/pitch corrections, and enhancing your sound with effects. This tutorial is ideal for anyone interested in producing high-quality acoustic guitar recordings with Ableton Live Lite.

items.human_name: Mastering Audio Effects and Creative Automation in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to apply effects and automation in Ableton Live. She covers adding reverb, saturation, EQ, and compression to drums, bass, and vocals, using return tracks for efficient CPU usage. Anna also explains creating vocal effects with send/return tracks and automating parameters like filter cutoffs and delay settings for transitions. This session highlights practical tips for improving your mix and achieving polished results by using automation creatively in your tracks.

items.human_name: Turning your song into an Ableton Live looping performance
items.description: This course teaches you how to create a live looping performance in Ableton Live using techniques like MIDI mapping, resampling, and follow actions. Designed for drummers and live performers, it covers exporting from Arrangement to Session View, building a CPU-efficient set, and using tools like Max for Live devices. You’ll follow along with Vicky O’Neon as she demonstrates using her own track “Cold As.” This course is ideal for performers looking to integrate Ableton Live into their live sets.

items.human_name: Recording Vocals on a Backing Track Using Audacity
items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to record vocals over a backing track using Audacity. You’ll learn to set up your recording environment, record multiple takes, edit and compile the best parts, and apply effects like EQ and compression for clarity. It’s ideal for aspiring musicians, podcasters, and voice-over artists looking to improve their recording skills with free software. The course covers everything from room acoustics to finalizing your vocal track for a professional sound.

items.human_name: Recording Electric Guitar with Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to record electric guitar in Ableton Live Lite using free amp simulation plugins. Led by Arthur Carneiro, it covers setting up an audio interface, recording multiple takes, applying effects like EQ and compression, and arranging tracks for a polished mix. The course is designed for guitarists and producers using Ableton Live Lite and provides practical tips for enhancing guitar recordings with plugins like Bluecat Free Amps and Black Rooster Cypress TT.

This tutorial covers vocal mixing techniques in Audacity using Antares and Valhalla plugins. You’ll learn to apply EQ, autotune, de-essing, reverb, and echo, as well as creating parallel channels for a rich vocal mix. Ideal for producers and vocalists aiming to enhance their recordings with professional-quality mixing techniques. Suitable for those with basic vocal recording and editing knowledge.

This trumpet masterclass is designed for electronic musicians interested in writing for orchestral instruments. It covers trumpet articulations, composing realistic trumpet lines using VSTs, and communicating effectively with trumpet players. The course also explores different trumpet styles like orchestral, jazz, and soul. Led by Helen Noir, this class is ideal for composers, arrangers, and producers wanting to achieve lifelike trumpet sounds in their projects using tools like SWAM Solo Brass. Suitable for both live musicians and VST programming.

This tutorial teaches how to create dynamic basslines using Ableton Live’s Analog Synth. You’ll learn to set up MIDI devices, edit MIDI clips, and apply sound design techniques like using oscillators, filters, and envelopes. The course is perfect for beginners and aspiring producers aiming to enhance their music production skills. It covers everything from MIDI routing to adding automation for movement in your basslines, making it an ideal guide for those new to synth-based bass creation in Ableton Live.

items.human_name: Creative Vocal Looping With BOSS Loop Stations
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to creatively use BOSS Loop Stations for live vocal looping. You'll learn beatboxing, audio routing, layering loops, and structuring performances. Ideal for vocalists, loop artists, and music producers interested in live looping techniques. Led by Grace Savage, a UK beatboxing champion and electronic-pop artist, the course offers practical skills to enhance live performances using voice and live recordings. Suitable for beginners and those exploring the potential of BOSS Loop Stations in musical composition and performance.

items.human_name: Sketch Musical Ideas with Ableton Note
items.description: This tutorial covers how to use Ableton Note, an iOS app for sketching musical ideas. You’ll learn how to configure Note, build beats, sample sounds, and export projects to Ableton Live via Ableton Cloud. The course is ideal for beginners, sound designers, and music producers interested in exploring creative workflows on mobile devices. Led by Ableton Certified Trainer Phelan Kane, it offers hands-on guidance for using Note’s tools to capture and develop ideas efficiently.

items.human_name: Treating Synth Bass in Ableton Live
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to treat a bass synth in Ableton Live using native effects. You’ll learn to apply stereo separation, mid-side EQ, saturation, and gain structuring to enhance bass presence and clarity. Techniques like sidechain compression are also covered to prevent frequency clashes with drums. Ideal for producers focused on bass-heavy genres like EDM and hip-hop, the course offers practical mixing tips for achieving a solid, well-balanced low-end in your tracks.

items.description: We envision a world in which all children can pursue a quality education that enables them to reach their full potential and contribute to their communities and the world. Room to Read seeks to transform the lives of millions of children in low-income communities by focusing on literacy and gender equality in education. Working in collaboration with local communities, partner organizations and governments, we develop literacy skills and a habit of reading among primary school children, and support girls to complete secondary school with the relevant life skills to succeed in school and beyond.
Think dogs, cats, fish, and turtles! Paint a lifelike critter, complete with realistic fur and tail, using this pack that has all of your favorite animals in mind.
These time-saving brushes create dotted, spotty and lined patterns with varying degrees of solidity that save you the time of placing individual strokes.

Capture and edit professional quality multi-camera productions – the perfect choice for creating gaming videos, music videos, tutorial videos, product demos, cooking videos, unboxing videos, and more! Easily record your screen, webcam video, and audio simultaneously with the click of a button and import additional media to make projects shine Preview all the camera feeds together and adjust the color and brightness of each cam
Alcohol ink will have you attaining beautiful ink pours. Fluid and transparent, each spill will delight you with shape and movement. A truly immersive painting experience.

Apply expressive brushstrokes using the Gestural Illustration Brush Pack, which is based on the subjective movement of a painter's arm or hand. These brushes can help you create organic gestures without eliminating the graphite/pen to paper feeling while working digitally. These brushes capture the essence of movement and direction defined by this form of illustration.

Birds of a feather flock together. The Feather brush pack is equipped with light but detailed brushstrokes designed to elevate your digital artwork to a new level. Experiment with Parrot, Peacock, Raven and Pheasant to make your canvas soar.
Brushes that blow bubbles? Experience these effervescent brushes containing gases that form all kinds of traditional and unique bubbly shapes that will never pop.

Paint a single drop of rain or millions of droplets cascading from the sky. Painting rain washes everything anew, bringing puddles into which ducks and children splash! Experience the realistic effects of drenching, drizzling, and storming with these expressive rain brushes.
If you don't have time to hatch in every stroke, let the Rake Brush Pack do it for you pronto! Hatch and blend to perfection with beautiful blunt, gritty and woven variants.

This collection of textured brushes is meant to roughen up your illustrations with expressive, hard edged, graphic style. Inspired by baked, bumpy, scratched and just plain rugged elements, your art will be sure to make an impression.
A great complement to the original Manga pack or to use alone, this pack is meant to provide you with the right brushes to back up your imagination and create simple and clean characters.
See the light in a whole new way! Whether you want to add a soft glow to your sunset photo, or insert sizzling rays into a painting, these breathtaking brushes will provide just the glow you need.
Add another level of intensity to your artwork with distressed scrapes and scratch marks. Wield your brushes with wild strokes to create anything from scratchy and scrappy to gritty and gruff.
Transform your canvas into vibrant and colorful floating ink using this in paper marbling pack. These uniques brushes reproduce patterns reminiscent of stone with an artistic spin.
Bring any conceptual idea to life with crazy, erratic, spiro or globular brushes that push and pull with wild spirals and infinite possibilities in this pack.

Add some sparkly firework calligraphy into any illustration or photo with your own intentions and creativity. Each brush is made to benefit the other brushes in the pack so that all goes well when you want to have fun embellishing your image without overdoing it - unless you simply want to get carried away.

Imagine foliage sprouting from the tip of your brush. Create expansive orchards filled with dandelions or draw a lone spiny cactus growing from desert dirt. Expand the reach of your garden to include vines, plants, gravel, grass and more.

Explore Video Masking tools, Color Grading controls, and enhanced keyframing, and tap into hundreds of creative effects and pro-caliber tools. redeem_text: Unbridled miniature madness. Hope you’re stocked on resin, because this bundle of 3D printable fantasy miniatures from the wizards at Hayland Terrain are going to put your fab to work. Included is a veritable horde of characters and monsters, ranging from humanoids straight out of central casting and tabletop stalwarts like mimics and gelatinous cubes, to off-the-wall originals, like the denizens of an infernal carnival. You’ll also get a ton of scenery to bring to life thriving cityscapes, cozy taverns, ancient ruins, and more. Pay what you want for more than a hundred individual sets of 3D printable assets and help support the Make-A-Wish foundation! Pay $1 or more. Normally, the total cost for the software in this bundle is as much as $731. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum $1 purchase. Redeem DRM-Free. All of the software in this bundle is available DRM-Free. Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the developer and to support Make-A-Wish. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too! items.description: With "Semantic Color Palette", you can improve your workflow by using a semantic color management system. How does it work? You define a set of meaningful identifiers for colors, representing where/how each color is used (e.g. "buttonBackground"), and not the colors themselves (e.g. "darkBrown"). items.description: The colony in the Taoan system transmits a distress call and goes silent. On Coriolis station, the factions scramble to put together a rescue mission focused on the Ghazali, a decommissioned cruise liner. They wake up to alarms in the darkness on a crippled ship. What has happened? Can they survive the last voyage of the Ghazali? items.human_name: Tales From The Loop: Things From The Flood

They wandered about impatiently, restless in the new wind sweeping through the country. They smelled something in the air, something unfamiliar. Perhaps, if we had listened closely, we would also have heard it. We may have heard the sound rising from the forgotten and sealed caverns in the depths: the muffled pounding from something trying to get out. The Spire is driven through the skin of the world like a pin through curling paper. With every step toward the tower, it writhes and warps like a hallucination. It seems infinitely tall, like something in a dream. There is one silver door, marked with a pavonated eye in iridescent blue and green. items.description: MongoDB is a free, open-source document database that is both flexible, and scales, allowing you to manage querying and indexing. Learn how to set up MongoDB for your Node.js web applications, and learn the differences between databases, collections and documents, as well as how to interact with MongoDB Shell to import and export data. You will be shown how to load JSON files to query data,connect MongoDB to Node.js, work with Mongoose, and more.

JavaScript is one of the core pillars of web development, and is a must-know language for anyone interested in this industry. Learn highly transferable fundamental techniques and skills that will act as the basis of success in web development, mobile application development, server-side development and more. Gain a solid footing in object-oriented programming – one of the most important coding paradigms – all while building a game that works on all modern platforms.

items.human_name: Create Interactive Pages with JavaScript and the DOM API
items.description: Learn about the Document Object Model (DOM) and how it gives you the power to develop interactive web pages and dynamic widgets powered by JavaScript and HTML5. You'll then put your knowledge into practice by creating an interactive flashcards app, a list filtering app, and a booking system.

Build a "Frogger" style game, where the player helps the Valkyrie to dodge the dragons and claim the treasure. Using HTML5, JavaScript and Phaser, you will learn how to implement simple and intuitive mechanics, restart and win conditions, fixed player movement and more as you create a game that's playable across all modern platforms (mobile, desktop and web browser). Learn to work with sprites, detect user input, understand collision, incorporate basic camera effects and more.

You've created your Node.js App… but how do you set it up so that others can access it? This course will show you how to deploy your app to the Amazon Web Service (AWS), so that anyone can access your Node.js web app from a website, or from a phone application. Get acquainted with AWS and its dashboard, and learn how to work with an EC2 Instance (a virtual server run by Amazon), including how to connect it to your computer, deploy existing applications to it, and more.

items.human_name: Learn Angular by Creating a Web Application
items.description: This course will introduce you to Angular, the web development framework that allows you to create interactive web applications across a variety of platforms, including those that live on the web, mobile and desktop. As you create a simple recipe-based cooking app, you will learn how to harness Angular to create a CRUD application (where users can Create, Read, Update, and Delete recipes), featuring a modern UI, show pages, edit pages, a home page, and a navbar.

Redux is perfect for when you need to write applications that behave consistently, run in different environments, and that are easy to test. This course will both help you to understand what Redux is by showing you how to build it in just a few lines of code, and allow you to develop a comprehensive knowledge of it by walking you through the process of creating a fully-featured Hacker News/Reddit-style app, featuring users, posts, and comments.

Further your knowledge of Next.js, the minimalist framework that allows you to build static, server-rendered React Apps. You'll cement your knowledge by putting it into practice, and creating a game portfolio website. Learn how to create the project and add images, implement custom display blocks for images, titles, and descriptions, build secondary pages, apply Bootstrap and custom styling, mask the URL with server-side support, and more.

From understanding the different REST types, to developing an authentication flow using REST, and more, this course features must-know skills for web developers.

Learn the fundamental skills needed to utilize this versatile library, you'll learn all you need to know to get started before applying your knowledge to create a responsive website featuring a shop page and responsive form.

This course introduces to the open source programming language TypeScript. A superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript, this language works on all browsers, hosts and operating systems, and features optional static typing to the language. Perfect for developing large applications and JavaScript applications for client-side or server-side execution, this language is a must-know for anyone interested in web development.

Discover how to run your very own HTTP server ready to handle client requests, show HTML content and read from files, and - thanks to its event-driven system - handle multiple requests without worrying about the page load time. Cement your knowledge through a series of mini-projects, including parsing multiple data types according to their format, and creating a server log file for debugging your server.

Cascading Style Sheets – or CSS – is a style sheet language used for describing the presentation of a document that has been written in HTML. As one of the cornerstone technologies of the world wide web, knowledge of CSS is crucial when working with many of the most popular modern frameworks in web development. Learn the foundations of CSS and web design principles required to create a responsive page.

Based on Node.js and React, Next.js is a framework that allows you to build static, server-rendered React apps. This minimalist framework is incredibly easy to use, and allows you to create simple and sleek designs. Learn to navigate between pages, pass data into/receive data from URLs, Mask URLS, style pages with CSS (or external CSS libraries), export an app to HTML, deploy an app to a static hosting service, and more.

Get acquainted with the Express – the industry standard web development framework for Node.js. Streamline your web development process by using Bootstrap to develop websites and web apps. Based primarily on HTML and CSS, this open-source framework provides pre-formatted templates for common frames and widgets, eliminating the need to build a HTML frame and style each individual container and element from scratch. This course will enable you to drastically reduce your time and effort required for your build, and will help to ensure that your websites and web apps appear attractive and professional.

With Microsoft Azure, you can deploy your Node.js apps on a massive, global network, and ensure that your app can be accessible by others from a website or phone application. This course will teach you all about deploying your Node.js app to Microsoft Azure, including how to navigate the Azure Portal, core commands for working with web apps, pushing updates to your application, diagnosing and troubleshooting your apps, Git integration, and more.

GraphQL is a query language for APIs – it lets the client specify the exact data it needs, enables it to aggregate data from a number of sources, and uses a type system to describe the data. It also acts as a runtime for fulfilling the client's queries with your existing data, allows you to evolve APIs over time, and enables powerful developer tools. Master the basics of GraphQL by learning how to model your data using GraphQL syntax and Prisma, create a GraphQL Yoga and Prisma Binding, write and register mutations and queries, and more.

Hypertext Markup Language – or HTML – is the industry standard language that is used to create web pages and applications. As one of the cornerstone technologies of the world wide web, HTML is the foundation of many of the most popular modern frameworks in web development. Learn the foundations of HTML and its functions, and discover how it can be used to structure web pages and their content.

items.description: Prepare your 3D models for animation by learning the fundamentals of rigging in Blender! While working hands-on with a model in Blender, you’ll discover everything required for rigging – from setting up the “bones” to weight painting and controlling which parts of the mesh are affected by each bone. By the end, you’ll have the foundations you’ll need to master rigging any kind of 3D model and expand your skills in creating custom assets.

Find what you need in this Mega Bundle full of detailed, high-quality assets for games of every genre–everything from tilesets to build your perfect cursed school, map packs to design the dreariest dungeon, character generators for all your sprites, battlers, and faces, and music for every big moment and setting, from your darkest nightmares to your seediest cyber bars. Get over 100 asset packs to bring your game to life in Unreal Engine and Unity, and support Type 1 diabetes charity Breakthrough T1D with your purchase at the price of your choosing! Instructions can be found  here . Pay $5 or more. Normally, the total cost for the software in this bundle is as much as $2,040. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum $5 purchase. Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the publishers and to support Breakthrough T1D. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too! Want to build your own RPG with unique environments and exciting characters but just have no clue where to start? Find what you need in this Mega Bundle full of detailed, high-quality assets for games of every genre–everything from tilesets to build your perfect cursed school, map packs to design the dreariest dungeon, character generators for all your sprites, battlers, and faces, and music for every big moment and setting, from your darkest nightmares to your seediest cyber bars. items.human_name: Cursed Kingdoms Twisted Forest Music Pack
items.description: Return to the Cursed Kingdoms and venture outside the walls into the wilderness with twenty tracks of dark fantasy music from composer Joel Steudler! Ominous, eerie instruments and menacing metal guitars set the stage for spider attacks, terrifying trees, and an occasional rest at the campfire. Be sure to post a guard, though. You never know what's lurking in the night. Also includes fifteen music events to punctuate important moments!

items.human_name: Tiny Tales RPG Heroes: A New Beginning
items.description: Tiny Tales is designed for those who want to create a cutesy yet epic adventure scenario for their game. In TT Heroes: A New Beginning, you will find 8 unique and expertly crafted heroes for your game! The world has fallen prey to a corrupt order, and only those that band together to fight evil shall prevail! With this pack, you will have all the necessary tools to bring unique heroes to life in your game! Portraits, Side View Battlers, Static Battlers and Map Sprites, all included to start an epic journey!

items.human_name: Medieval Town and Country + Interiors Bundle
items.description: Everything you need is inside to create literally thousands of unique characters including their spritesheets (with over 50 animations supported!), facesets, busts, and paperdolls. On top of that, there are an absolute ton of tiles included for you to build the world you want to create. Each Medieval pack builds on the others, offering nearly countless combinations of characters and giving an ever-expanding vast library of tiles and other resources to build your dream game. These images are multifunctional and can be used as battlers, logos, or incorporated into other ambience within your game world. Specifically designed with form and shape in mind, these monsters have character all their own.

Space... the final frontier. The time has come where Earth is explored and charted and mankind must turn its collective attention upward, to the stars. This resource pack gives you the power to create your own sci-fi maps and games with a focus on a wide-range of interiors for ships, space stations, bases, buildings, and whatever else you can imagine.

This colorful set of Pixel Art portraits offers a wealth of variety for your game. Inspired by the likes of Stardew Valley and Final Fantasy IV, this pack brings to life a multitude of personalities, formatted in many different ways, to fully unlock their potential as well as to allow you ease of use within your specific game project.

items.description: Hungry Snake is a complete, sellable puzzle-platformer. You are a square snake: every apple makes you longer, but a snake with nothing under it falls, spikes kill from every side and the bottom of the world is an abyss. Eat all the apples to open the exit, then slither through it. There are 24 levels in 4 worlds (Meadow, Desert, Glacier, Midnight): three hand-made tutorials and 21 levels grown by a hill-climbing generator and kept only because the solver finished them, ordered by solver effort. Each level's par is the exact shortest solution, and three stars need par or close to it (1000 + 100

Balloons Up is a complete, sellable one-touch puzzle game with an original identity. Touch the screen to start a balloon, hold to inflate it, drag to aim and release to float it up; the balloon's size tier (1 to 4) is the damage it deals, bigger pops also splash the blocks beside the contact point, and you have a balloon budget per level. Blocks are brick walls with hit points, padlocks, unbreakable steel, sliding movers and sideways wind zones, laid out on a 12-column grid where the lowest block in a column shields the rest. There are 100 levels in 10 themed worlds (a hand-made tutorial, then

Retro Snake is a complete little Snake game and a clean base to build on, made as a Godot 4 template. You steer a snake around a wrap-around board, eat apples, grow and avoid biting yourself. Endless mode is the classic borderless game, Classic adds deadly walls, and Courses are six rock-filled levels with an apple goal each, stored as editable text files and checked by a bot. There are four difficulties (Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme) with scores kept per mode and difficulty, dynamic food that spawns only on free tiles, optional extra apples and a timed golden apple worth 50 every five apples.

Sweet Shop Match is a complete, sellable match-3 puzzle game with an original identity: a pink mascot, candy art drawn procedurally and a bright sweet-shop look. Swap two neighbouring candies to line up three or more; match 4 for a striped candy, an L or T for a wrapped candy, a 2x2 square for a fish and 5 for a rainbow candy, and swap two specials for combos up to a full-board clear. The whole ruleset lives in a node-free, deterministic simulation that turns every move into a list of events, so the screen only plays animation, a bot can play the rules and another front end can reuse them. 100

Match Blast is a complete tap-to-blast casual puzzle built as a Godot 4 template. You tap a group of two or more matching blocks to blast it; groups of five or more make a rocket, seven or more a bomb and nine or more a disco ball, and adjacent boosters combine and chain-react. Land near the centre for PERFECT combos (2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 points), tip off an edge or miss and the cube shatters. The endless course generator is seeded and deterministic, gets harder with smaller platforms and bigger gaps, and adds moving and crumbling platforms and gems. Vertical Journey is a one-tap, blocky 3D climbing game template for mobile and desktop, rebuilt from scratch in Godot 4 with no Unity assets or code. Dazzle is a complete, sellable 2D block-puzzle game. Drag pieces from a tray of three onto a 10x10 board with the mouse, touch, a keyboard cursor or a controller; fill a whole row or column to clear it. A landing shadow shows where a piece will go, the lines a drop would clear are highlighted, and an optional snap assist nudges a nearly legal drop onto a legal spot. Scoring is 1 point per cell plus base * n * (n + 1) / 2 for n lines cleared at once, multiplied by a combo level that carries over a few placements, plus a perfect-clear bonus for emptying the board. The Syntronik SAM is based on the Oberheim SEM synth. The SEM 2-pole filter has a gentler roll off slope at 12dB per octave than the Moog 4-pole filter at 24dB per octave.

The Syntronik Blau recreates the powerful wavetable synthesis sounds of the PPG Wave. Manufactured from 1981—1987, the Wave uses a digital sound generation system combined with analog filtering for a unique hybrid sound. Small digital samples are organized into “wavetables” in place of traditional analog oscillators. The wavetables can be scanned, meaning that an envelope, LFO or other modulation source can advance through several different sounds on the same note. You'll explore core strategy mechanics including unit movement, basic combat, and more while building a small RTS project in Unreal. The techniques here will provide you with base mechanics that can be expanded or used in other strategy-style games! You will learn how to: Make playable units Implement simple combat Navigate with Nav Mesh Provide UI-feedback for input Create RTS-appropriate cameras Improve level aesthetics

Build four beginner-friendly Unreal Engine mini-games! Unreal Engine empowers creators to bring imaginative ideas to life, making it a cornerstone tool across all genres. In this course, you’ll build a set of four mini-projects exploring concepts like UIs, physics, and core programming tenets with real-world techniques that strengthen your grasp of the editor. The practical skills you gain will give you the confidence to take the next step in your Unreal Engine journey - whether you want to build RPGs, walking simulators, FPS games, or something else. You’ll learn how to: Manipulate actor prop

items.human_name: Discover Game Audio for Unreal Engine
items.description: Explore how to use audio for Unreal Engine projects! Audio can play a vital role in games by creating atmosphere, providing players with feedback, and giving an immersive sense of presence. Through this course, you'll experiment with playing sounds in Unreal Engine and adjusting available settings to make your audio more dynamic. These skills will allow you to enhance the game feel of your Unreal Engine projects and work with background music, SFX, and more. You will learn how to: Alter sound attenuation Play background music Make dynamic SFX with randomness Give characters footsteps Add vario

items.human_name: Develop a 2D Platformer in Unreal Engine
items.description: Learn how to make 2D games using Unreal Engine! 2D remains an immensely popular art style for games and can be found across a multitude of genres - especially platformers. In this course, you'll build a 2D platformer while learning how to work with tilemaps, players, enemies, and more using Unreal Engine and a 2D art style. These skills will allow you to unlock Unreal Engine's capabilities for 2D games and give you the foundations to work with any kind of platformer project. You will learn how to: Create multiple platforming levels Set up player & enemy movement Implement collectible coins

items.human_name: The Complete Unreal Engine C++ Course - Build an FPS
items.description: Develop a complete first-person shooter in Unreal Engine using C++ programming! First-person shooters are popular for their performance and interactivity, and C++ empowers developers to create them efficiently. In this course, you'll build a fully-fledged FPS survival game with Unreal Engine and C++ while learning to create enemy waves, pickups, and other interactive game elements. These advanced techniques will enable you to leverage more customized FPS features with C++ and approach Unreal Engine development in a whole new way. You will learn how to: Create and program enemy classes Implemen

items.human_name: Create a Turn-Based Mini RPG in Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a turn-based mini RPG from start to finish in Unreal Engine! Turn-based battle systems offer strategic depth for creating immersive and engaging RPG experiences. In this course, you'll construct a 2.5D, turn-based RPG featuring magic spells, healing, and more - all with simple UI controls. These skills will empower you to expand into more sophisticated RPG development and master class construction using Unreal's Blueprints. You’ll learn how to: Create dynamic player/enemy classes Develop turn-based game logic Use UI for character control Build a 2.5D game world Work with projectiles and

items.human_name: Make a Fully-Fledged 3D Platformer with Unreal Engine
items.description: Bring your own 3D platformer to life with Unreal Engine from start to finish! 3D platformers stand as classics of the gaming world, celebrated for their dynamic movement and multi-layered levels. Through this course, you’ll craft a fully-fledged 3D platformer from the ground up, building core features like animated players, collectibles, enemies, and seamless level progression. These skills will not only deepen your understanding of Unreal Engine, but give you the confidence to design original platforming experiences or evolve existing ones. You'll learn how to: Set up a 3D player controller I

items.human_name: Make a Plane Arcade Game in Unreal Engine
items.description: Make a plane flying game in Unreal Engine! Planes are a popular subject matter for many genres thanks to their unique and inspiring ability to fly in real life. You'll learn to build an arcade-style game where players must fly through rings to increase their score. These techniques will provide you with new structures for tracking scores, implementing movement, and more for your Unreal projects. You will learn how to: Process inputs Script pitch, roll, and yaw Control plane acceleration Build a ring-based course Track scoring with UI Create 3D environments with Quixel ... and more!

Discover how the core concepts of game design can help you to create fun and intuitive games! Game design is a fundamental process needed when creating any game - from the smallest platformer to the largest MMORPG. In this course, you'll start mastering the foundations of game design by examining each core component and how they apply to real-world games. By the end, you'll understand both why game design is important and, more crucially, how to apply the concepts to your own games and create a stunning portfolio. You will learn how to: Plan a game around a core mechanic or experience Engage p

items.human_name: Intro to Unreal Engine Game Development
items.description: Take your first step into Unreal Engine game development! Unreal Engine stands at the forefront of professional game development, powering everything from breakout indie hits to AAA blockbusters. Through this course, you’ll get hands-on with the Unreal Editor, master core mechanics, and build simple interactive examples using the Blueprints Visual Scripting system. With these skills, you'll unlock the foundation to craft immersive experiences and pursue more advanced Unreal Engine projects. You'll learn how to: Navigate the Unreal Editor interface Work with actors and game objects Set up and m

items.human_name: Develop a Classic Shoot 'em up with Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a 3D arcade shooter from start to finish in Unreal Engine! Shoot ‘em ups are a timeless genre that has vastly influenced and shaped the landscape of action games. In this course, you’ll create your own shoot ‘em up in Unreal Engine while learning player controls, dynamic enemy spawning, collision systems, and interactive UI development. These practical, multifaceted skills can be used not just for building shoot 'em ups, but also for exploring new game genres with Unreal. You'll learn how to: Build player movement and shooting logic Design modular enemy-spawning systems Implement precise

items.human_name: Create a Fully-Fledged Bullet Hell in Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a bullet hell game from start to finish in Unreal Engine! Bursting across screens with relentless action, bullet hell games are a thrilling staple of game development that push technical and creative boundaries. In this course, you’ll create a fully-fledged 3D bullet hell, mastering real-world techniques essential for managing enemies, optimizing gameplay, and delivering an engaging experience. By the end, you’ll have a robust project to showcase your Unreal Engine skills and the confidence to create action-oriented titles of your own. You'll learn how to: Set up Unreal’s Enhanced Input

items.human_name: Develop a Complete Infinite Runner in Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a fully-fledged, 2.5D infinite runner for Unreal Engine! Infinite runners are a cornerstone genre, offering endless replay value and a deep dive into modular, dynamic gameplay systems. In this course, you'll develop a complete infinite runner game from start to finish, mastering core foundations in animation, level generation, and more. These skills will not only give you essential skills for infinite runners, but provide you with fundamentals that can easily be applied to roguelikes, platformers, and many other genres. You’ll learn how to: Create moveable actors Animate player character

items.human_name: Intro to Multiplayer in Unreal Engine
items.description: Discover how to add multiplayer to your Unreal Engine games! Multiplayer is a highly in-demand feature that can greatly enhance player experiences or completely define the gameplay. In this course, you'll create a multiplayer point-collecting game while exploring the fundamentals of how multiplayer works in Unreal Engine - which can be applied to any Unreal project. You will learn how to: Understand basic networking & RPCs Explore Unreal settings for multiplayer Control inputs and players per device Render player states across computers Manage one-time pickups Update UIs across players ...

items.human_name: Build a 2.5D Farming RPG with Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a farming simulation game using Unreal Engine! Farming simulation games offer players the chance to create, grow, and manage their own virtual farms, combining strategic planning with RPG-like gameplay to create an immersive experience. In this course, you’ll develop a 2.5D farming simulation from scratch – covering core features like player controls, farming mechanics, and a basic economic system. These skills will give you the tools you need to create more complex farming games and expand into other genres with Unreal Engine. You’ll learn how to: Set up player movement and inputs Add i

Discover UI and UX design principles for games! The user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) play a critical role in communicating information to players and creating smooth, interactive gameplay. In this course, you'll build a UI/UX mockup for a mobile game while exploring design methodologies and wireframing techniques. These techniques will provide you new ways to approach UI/UX game design and to meaningfully apply iterative design to optimize your game's experience. You will learn how to: Understand users with user stories Create definitive design criteria Utilize wireframes for mocku

Discover tips and techniques for designing game narratives! You'll learn by studying real games, and master a variety of methods for telling stories through characters, plots, mechanics, and more. No matter what type of games you want to build, the skills you'll learn will help to make your games more immersive and engaging for your players. You will learn how to: Understand technical story design Create compelling protagonists & antagonists Base your story on a three-act structure Use game-based methods to convey your story Incorporate interactive, choice-based storytelling Advance the st

items.human_name: Create a Racing Game in Unreal Engine
items.description: Make an arcade-style racing game in Unreal Engine! Whether stylized or hyper-realistic, racing games are a popular genre due to their all-ages nature and easy-to-understand mechanics. In this course, you'll build a racing game while learning how to set up a car and a track that can manage laps. These techniques will give you the foundations to expand any sort of racing game and gain a deeper understanding of Blueprints techniques for vehicles in general. You will learn how to: Implement a race track environment Add inputs suited to vehicles Set up a race car Detect racing progress Control UIs

items.human_name: Learn 3D Modeling with Blender from Scratch
items.description: Master the foundations of Blender and 3D modeling! 3D modeling, the process of creating digital 3D objects, is a robust field of study with real-world applications for animation, game development, and more. In this course, you'll explore the free and open-source Blender software and learn the fundamental techniques for manipulating meshes and creating custom assets. These skills will form the basis for expanding your 3D modeling skills and open up opportunities to create unique assets for your projects. You will learn how to: Understand how 3D objects work Move, rotate, and scale objects Edit

items.human_name: Build a Complete Stealth Game with Unreal Engine
items.description: Create a fully-fledged 3D stealth game! Stealth gameplay is a cornerstone of modern action and adventure games, known for its tense strategies and immersive experiences. In this course, you'll build a complete stealth combat game in Unreal Engine, focusing on advanced enemy AI and dynamic stealth mechanics. With these skills, you'll be ready to specialize further in AI-driven design and tackle complex, real-world Unreal Engine projects in multiple genres. You'll learn how to: Design advanced enemy patrol systems Implement field of view mechanics Integrate real-time sound detection Build stealt

items.human_name: Intro to Rigging Models in Blender
items.description: Prepare your 3D models for animation by learning the fundamentals of rigging! Rigging is a key animation technique that involves creating a skeletal armature to manipulate a 3D mesh and streamline the animation process. In this course, you'll discover everything required for rigging - from setting up the "bones" to weight painting and controlling which parts of the mesh are affected by each bone. By the end, you'll have the foundations you'll need to master rigging any kind of 3D model and expand your skills in creating custom assets. You will learn how to: Create bones to build an armature Co

items.human_name: First-Person Exploration Game in Unreal Engine
items.description: Build a fully-fledged first-person exploration game using Unreal Engine! First-person exploration games captivate players by immersing them in interactive worlds, where storytelling and discovery are at the core of the experience. In this course, you’ll develop a modular first-person exploration game inside Unreal Engine, mastering key systems that empower you to craft compelling puzzles, environments, and interactive stories. By the end, you’ll possess reusable tools and in-depth techniques to bring a wide range of first-person games to life. You'll learn how to: Set up a first-person control

items.human_name: Make a Horror Game in Unreal Engine
items.description: Learn how to make fully-fledged horror games in Unreal Engine! Horror games are a flexible genre that offers developers unique opportunities to explore spooky aesthetics and atmospheres. Through this course, you'll build a horror game where the player must avoid a monster and collect items - all while managing their flashlight's battery power. The techniques featured here will allow you to unlock level design suitable for the horror game genre that can easily be applied to any project. You will learn how to: Design horror levels and lighting Implement a flashlight object Create a player-chasin

items.human_name: Build a Tower Defense Game in Unreal Engine
items.description: Create a complete tower defense game in Unreal Engine! Tower defense games combine the best of strategy and creativity, making them a favorite among gamers. In this course, you’ll build a tower defense game while exploring character blueprints, animations, tile maps, and scalable game mechanics to develop a polished project that demonstrates the power of 2.5D gameplay. Mastering these skills will help you create modular tower defense games and expand into more advanced Unreal Engine projects. items.description: Create a mini-survival game using Unreal Engine! Survival games are a staple of the industry with a unique ability to work in just about any setting. These techniques will allow you to adapt any project for the survival game genre with universal concepts that can easily be expanded to suit your needs. Yog-Sothoth measures 110 mm / 4.33 in and is separated into multiple parts for easier printing, assembly and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

This second collection features the Haunter of the Dark at 150 mm / 5.91 in and 200 mm / 7.87 in, an Elder Thing at 75 mm / 2.95 in, four Serpent People and three Mi-Go at 40–50 mm / 1.57–1.97 in, plus the 50 mm / 1.97 in Shining Trapezohedron. A full unsplit Haunter is included. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Unlike the distant gods of the Mythos, Nyarlathotep walks among mankind, taking countless forms and spreading madness in the service of the Outer Gods. This Crawling Chaos miniature is supplied at 110 mm / 4.33 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in. A full unsplit version is also included for one-piece printing. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

Includes printable STL files for all four creatures.

Separate parts are supplied alongside full-model and combined body/base versions for larger single-piece prints. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

Includes Cthulhu at 120 mm / 4.72 in, with Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files. A full unsplit version is also included for those who prefer to print the model in one piece.

items.description: Being able to develop applications for Azure is becoming a must-have skill for .NET developers. In the typical React data flow, components communicate with each other via props. A parent passes props down to child components. Sometimes the intermediary components get props passed to them with the sole purpose of passing that data down one (or several) more levels deep. This cascade of props is often referred to as "prop drilling". The React Context API provides a way to pass data to components without having to pass props manually at every single level.

items.description: 3AM' by Producer Loops combines elements of Progressive House, Melodic House and Techno with some subtle references to Trance and even some distant Trip Hop reminiscences. This pack perfectly covers the whole spectrum of sounds and moods laid out by pivotal artists as diverse as Lane 8, Franky Wah, Ben Bohmer, Avoure, and Jordin Post.

Disco Pimp' by Producer Loops provides a staggering supply of Nu Disco content in a colourful and playful fusion of soulful upbeat grooves, bouncy basslines, syncopated vocal cuts, funky keyboards and fat analog synths. Inspired by artists such as Oliver, Lenno, Dua Lipa, Doja Cat and Ava Max, this pack guarantees some serious fun-filled all-nighters on the dance-floor.

Bliss' is a brand-new sample pack by Laniakea Sounds filled with unique atmospheric vocal ad-libs and complex soft vocal textures, suitable for a variety of musical genres. After the huge success of previous vocal sample packs, Laniakea Sounds continues to record some unique stuff in their studio.

Middle Eastern Cinema' is a 1GB collection of five enigmatic construction kits focused on the 'Hollywood' style of Middle-Eastern themes film music. It includes processed Kemanche, Oud, Ney, Setar and Taar recordings. All content was recorded and produced by Iranian producer, Ehsan Hesaraki.

Dark Realm' by Producer Loops features an outstanding collection of live recorded Foley sounds strongly geared towards Horror, Suspense and Thriller scores. This product is perfectly suitable for Movie Trailers and Film Scores, but also can be used in the production of Modern Electronic Music genres such as Trance, Ambient, Electronica, Downtempo, Chillout, Trap and more!
