items.description: What About: EDM Ammo' is an ultimate sample pack inspired by the wildest 2017 EDM festival tunes and producers. EDM scene is growing every day and so should you! EDM Ammo by W. A. Production will provide you the finnest melody progressions, construction kits, drums and presets for your favorite synthesizers - simply everything you need to create your own festival anthem!

Have we got a sweet treat for you? Just imagine the feeling of anticipation as your download completes, salivating as you load up the samples and delightfully create a mix that is just bursting with flavor. We are giving you some seriously juicy, light-hearted, feel good, dance sounds. What About: EDM & Dance Lollipop isn’t just covering one specific design. Included in this pack are a wide variety of colorful instruments such as electric and acoustic guitar, piano, bells, shakers, and toms.

Are you seeking audio samples that are as diverse as your style? EDM Vishnu from W. A. Production is loaded with over 3GB of off the charts EDM sounds. Inspired by such artists as KSHMR, Dropgun, Timmy Trumpet, 22Bullets, Jetfire and more to offer you the widest variety of amazing samples to add to your library.

Presenting HEAT 2 - the original twin distortion powerhouse, now with a stunning refresh. This face-melting plugin features an intuitive new interface, more accurate frequency monitoring and a host of under-the-hood improvements.

W. A. Productions presents What About: Future Bass Megalodon! An amazingly action pack filled pack, FULL of excitement and high end Presets and Samples. This pack is more pulled around that aggressive Future Bass and has inspiration from Melodic Dubstep. With the best sound designers on the market, we have carefully sculpted some amazing Construction Kits, FX, Melody Loops, Synth Shots, Serum Presets and Drum Loops and 1 shots!

Presenting COMBUSTOR - a unique way to create personalized compressor timbres. This inspirational effect features adaptive saturation processing to add character and crunch to your audio, all within a single plugin.
An outstandingly beautiful Future Pop inspired pack that is 100% one of the best Future Pop sample packs on the market to date!
Big EDM presents Broken Trap. Welcome to the world of head knocking drums, booming bass and experimental sound design.

Big EDM is proud to present a brand new huge collection of vocal shouts, loops, and melodies which will be extremely useful to all EDM genres like electro, progressive, tech house, deep house, trap, and dubstep.

If you are wanting to create an uplifting and relaxing tropical house sound with the foundational elements of real house music, we welcome you to audio paradise with Tropical House Pleasure from Big EDM. Dive right into an oasis of catchy melodies shaped with an epic coastal influence. Start from scratch with any of the interchangeable audio samples or reconstruct a mix from any of the 12, yes 12, construction kits.

Puncher 2 is a Multi-FX plug-in that will add instant power and punch to your tracks. In terms of compression, this is the all in one tool you’ve been dreaming of. Packed into its compact design you will find 3 different effects.
Riddim has been a dominating genre in the EDM scene as of late, with names like Spag Heddy, Virtual Riot, Eh!de, Panda Eyes and Midnight Tyrannosaurus making big moves in the Riddim genre.

Nothing beats the tropics in the summer. Festivals, exotic food and drinks, the music is as endless as the sea. Big EDM is letting you take that experience with you with their latest release Tropical House Aroma. A sensational pack that is complete with all of the sounds you need to create your own Tropical House mix. Tropical House Aroma from Big EDM is inspired by such artists as Kygo, Thomas Jack, Sam Feldt, and Felix Jaehn.
Perfectly crafted by some of the worlds best producers and sound designers, Big EDM – Hexa Future Sounds is here to bring those high quality samples and presets as always.

For decades, audio engineers have used a certain processing trick on vocals to help lacklustre mono vocals leap from stereo speakers. Now you can replicate that secret technique with one simple plugin. Vocal Splitter is a handy one-stop unit for turning mono vocals into thick, modern-sounding stereo. When we developed this plugin we went one stage further, including frequency and drive parameters to help your vocal performances stand out from the crowd. Of course, you can also this plugin on audio other than vocals... download the demo and give it a try.

Whether you're composing a film score, building an epic EDM track, or working on your new viral TikTok video, cinematic FX sounds can be incredible tools for creating drama, suspense, and impactful moods of all kinds. However, the quality of these sounds is key, which is why we tasked our top-quality experts with creating one of our best FX packs ever -- What About: Cinematic FX!

For a vocal to really cut through the mix and ride other instruments, it’s usually a good idea to make sure it’s loud and proud. However, the dynamics of a vocalist’s performance can vary wildly, from softly sung verses to strident choruses. Despite a comprehensive vocal effects chain, with careful volume-riding and compression, you’ll often need a final limiter to clamp down on fluctuating dynamics or to smooth slower phrases.

The violin is a classic instigator of all types of emotions. From suspense to tragedy. Twangy and upbeat to totally staccato (unpredictable). A violin quivers and pierces with galvanizing shrieks, and like the changing of a chameleons colors, it morphs into a sound that is elegantly beautiful and inspiring. Big EDM has captured the essence of the violin and paired it with a wide variety of complimentary electro synth, bass, and drum sounds.

Orchestral sounds can breathe fresh life into songs of any genre due to their universal popularity and organic construction. But getting high-quality, realistic orchestral sounds can often be a challenge. That's why we're bringing you this sequel to one of our most popular packs -- What About: Dramatic Orchestra Toolkit 2!
Introducing Big EDM – Melodic Deep Voodoo, a pack that is jam packed full of crazy melodic sounds that will being an intense and deep feel to your tracks.

Capturing that perfect vocal take is difficult, but knowing how to process vocals can be even trickier. The first step in the chain is often compression, but with so many different types of compressors to choose from which is the perfect solution for your vocals? We’ve created Vocal Compressor to solve that problem, featuring a compression chain that’s transparent, balanced and adds subtle flavour, colour and grit to make vocals sit perfectly in a mix.

As a famous vocalist once sang, “It’s all about the bass” and in as far as most genres of music are concerned, she’d be correct! Bass line balancing has always been a big challenge for producers, especially at the mixing stage, as the dynamic range of low end material can be huge.

Are you ready to get retro and slide into synthwave? We present to you What About: Synthwave Arcade sample pack. These are the sounds you’ve never heard before. A modern fusion of old-school classic sounds blended together in a way that has never been done before. We’ve got the funk of nu-disco, the past future atmosphere from the 80’s, and rhythmically thumping retro wave synths giving you this inventive hybrid spin on synthwave.
Ever have a creative stand still? Check out What About: EDM Assault. This pack is going to spark the creativity and give your sound a true unique and individual touch.

Inspired by today's chart-topping future pop artists such as VNV Nation, Icon of Coil as well as future bass artists Flume and Marshmello, Future Pop Ghost from W. A. Production gives you the sounds you need to create beautiful and impacting tracks.

You probably heard the filthy growls of Vomitstep introduced by the sound design genius - Snails. Pioneered by Getter, Snails and Skrillex, those nasty growls undoubtedly are taking over the dubstep scene by storm.

The dark, heavy, and futuristic sounds often found in Bass Music can also be some of the most complex to create. But if you don’t have hours to spend on designing a single sound, what are your options? Well, you’re in luck, because that’s precisely why we created What About: Cybernetic Bass Music!

Sometimes, it's important to take time just to relax and chill. While a beach and a nice drink can be great, the right music is essential to enhance the vibe. With What About: Lofi Chill, we give you all the tools you'll need to create the right environment for a relaxed mood.

It's time to break away from the tech-house stigma and get back to the roots of what made this music exciting. W. A. Production puts that ripping groove and energetic soul back into tech-house with Fishy Tech House.

With the ubiquity of streaming, chill music has experienced a major resurgence due to its effectiveness as good background music during a multitude of activities. We've been getting a lot of requests for tools suitable for more relaxed musical styles, so we were inspired to create What About: Electric Chill for you all!

W. A. Production presents the perfect marriage between organic and electronic sounds in their latest release, What About Dance Vibrations. This beautifully comprised pack contains 5 construction kits that paint a vast landscape with vibrant upbeat sounds that are sure to inspire your creativity and refresh any stagnant projects.

Get the party raging all night, and hard, with Hardstyle Mania from Big EDM. Welcome to a monstrous environment with melodically charactiaristic leads. Adrenaline enthusiasts will enjoy the relentless pounding and gouging of the overdriven kick sounds.

Big EDM is staying in the lead bringing you guys the latest sounds so you can be the first to unleash totally original tracks with the best in Future House. Future House Neptune is loaded with 2.34GB of possibilities. We’ve got the staple "go to" sounds to lay down your foundation including, formed traditional hi-hats, frequency modulated bass lines, elastic style drops and electro snares. On top of that, we've got the most solidified loops that are never monotonous or emulate what is already out there.
Experience the gripping storytelling sounds of the Cello and the Oud with "Cello and Oud For Electro" from Big EDM.
The hottest property on the floor right now, G-House. And who is offering up the most creatively intelligent G-House Pack? W. A. Production. We present you What About: G House Root.
With over 600 of the most revolutionary, inventive sounds of dance floor disco fever your mix will have the movers shaking and the shakers moving.

What About: Lofi Illusion from W. A. Production is an audio sample pack that delivers a 1950's Motown feel with a 1960's psychedelic approach to Lo-Fi. Inspired by such artists as Knowledge, Sleepy Fish, Jinsang, and Lofty with the professional sounding quality to match.

The ultimate sound bank / sample pack inspired by Alok and Confession (the label by mastermind Tchami) is here to give you a hand in dominating the Brazilian Bass or G House scene.
Brazilian Bass music is dominating the house scene right now with its driving basslines, abstract synths, experimental sound design and groovy drum loops.
Here we are again with an another amazing pack for you guys! Big EDM – Future Pop is one of the most stunning and well rounded packs we have made.

However hard you try, capturing a perfect vocal is an almost impossible task. Contending with plosives and pops, crackles and clicks, has driven many a producer to distraction. The first hurdle is getting your dry vocal track as pristine as possible and fixing all those troublesome little audio imperfections.

Big EDM has fused the power of 2 into one and is rolling out their Hybrid Trap Grizzly Pack. Featuring multi-layered hard-lined and melodic synth leads, crisp, grimy, rhythmic snares, and similarly divided hi-hats.

We love to give producers, beginner and professional, as many recourses, like presets, drum samples, drum loops melody loops etc., as we possibly can. However, we did something huge this time around. We brought you one of the most amazing and quality vocal packs on the sample pack market.

Choose from additional one hits, fx, melodies and presets that we have included.

items.description: Another project based in Geometry Nodes. The animation utilizes proximity to control the shape and movement of instances arranged in a typeface-specific string. The final result dynamic and emphasized.
Blurring the lines between the macro and product rendering genres. Or should I say bokeh blurring the lines...

A symbol of trying your luck; taking a risk. This project is a fun introduction to the macro aesthetic, where high fidelity detail is paramount and bokeh blur narrows viewer focus. Rigid body simulation also makes a cameo.
Semi-abstract exercise that explores the visual interest of shapes cast by light and shadow. The setup is fast, simple, freeform, and wide-open to iteration.

Craft the peace and tranquility of early morning. This project draws your attention to the beautiful details of leafy organics. We will utilize micropolygon displacement for maximum geometric fidelity. Along with simple rigging and f-curve modifier power.

A more grounded application of the light shape hallway exercise that leans into photorealistic interior spaces. Another example of basic shapes looking better than they should with competent materials and interesting lighting.
Can we create a realistic environment that feels enormous using minimalistic techniques? Yes. Yes we can.

Embrace complimentary contrast in this simple, satisfying animation. Unlike other macro projects, depth of field is not applicable here. Instead we will lean on micropolygon displacement to achieve a believable level of detail at such a close proximity.

Settle in with a warm brew. Increasing the complexity, this next scene grows richer and more tactile as we shape a soft, inviting rug with the geo-nodes hair system, let subtle procedural steam rise from our cup, and place simple exterior elements to paint the interior with expressive shadow patterns.

Take the first step. The introduction into the interior vignettes focuses on just the architecture, with simple modeling techniques combined with modifiers. Learn how procedural textures combined with interesting lighting and reflections can make the most basic scene look compelling.

We've tasted the power of Geometry Nodes but now it's time for a complete meal! This cinematic title reveal transitions from molten lava to cooled metal. The perfect style for that movie you're working on

An elegant, timeless instrument with repetitive shape complexity - perfect for fast creation. The material plays a key role in tactile realism while the glowing orbs serve as unique flare and interesting bokeh fodder.

Uncover the mystery of the flowers in the forgotten house. Adapting pre-existing assets to fit the narrative, this project shifts the focus more towards the story-telling, utilizing particles dancing in atmospheric lighting and the power of the compositor to add the right amount of tension to the scene.

Manifest the slow down, bright sunny vibes of summer. Learn to utilize Blender's ocean modifier to simulate body-of-water behavior. Then discover the trick to make that behavior loop seamlessly. And finally, capture mesmerizing bokeh shapes as they dance on the water's surface.

Create an adorable graphic environment that loops endlessly between day and night. Zero light objects are used, meaning every shade of color is achieved with shader nodes. Render times are zippity zoppity.

Zooming out farther to reveal more of the room, this scene opens the interior toward the world beyond, where a simple image blends with the sky texture to suggest an inviting exterior. Bean bag chairs created using cloth simulation offer a relaxed place to settle in and watch the sunset unfold in a gentle time lapse.
Kick off the course with a simple project that artistically obscures rotating text behind an array of glass cylinders. It's the first example of easy concepts that radically affect the final result.

Travel back in time and visit an ancient temple. Subdivision surface techniques create elegant columns, while the true centerpiece is a procedural marble material which flows across every part of the scene. As the camera moves, shifting lights guide the eye, drawing attention exactly where the story wants it to rest.

Turn your attention to a single, graceful subject: a curtain caught in the wind. Cloth simulation and wind forces shape its movement, procedural materials bring depth and texture, and a simple trick turns the motion into a seamless looping animation.
Utilizing procedural textures to generate animated loops for practical and artistic purposes. This chapter features four distinct looping patterns, each building on the principles of the previous.

Monochromatic outer space. Can you feel the drama? This scene is designed to inspire cinematic awe. Discover how the most basic, primitive geometry can look incredible with the right materials and lighting.

items.description: Take a more artistic approach to architectural concept design. Follow along as award-winning designer/director Maxim Zhestkov reveal all the tools in his kit. Learn techniques in Cinema 4D, Arnold Renderer, and Photoshop to create your very own set of breathtaking images, including an immersive 360° render.

Follow along as industry-leading artist Gaelle Seguillon teaches you her process for creating captivating and lifelike worlds, like the ones she has created for films like Ready Player One, Aladdin, and Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. Starting with the fundamentals of composition, you'll learn to create eye-catching sketches, techniques to create photobash concept art, how to build entire scenes in Blender, and realistically render using Octane. You'll finish the course with a set of portfolio pieces featuring environments you might wish you could visit!

Learn to communicate a narrative idea using a variety of simple, yet effective Photoshop and painting techniques. Industry veteran Jama Jurabaev will show students shortcuts to stay focused on the creative aspect of their work rather than the technical.

If you've ever felt overwhelmed by ZBrush, you've come to the right place. Follow along as concept artist Alex Figini takes you through his entire process for creating complex characters and props for films and games. Covering everything from basic principles to advanced sculpting techniques, this course is a robust toolkit for concepting with ZBrush, Marvelous Designer, and Keyshot.

Your concept art will never be the same. Industry veteran Jan Urschel is here to show you how to build major production assets following a professional brief. By covering architecture, design and visualization, learn to approach your concept art from a theoretical and technical standpoint. With Jan's help, learn how to be a DOP of your own creations.

The hotly anticipated conclusion to Louis Laurent's groundbreaking first course is here to help you rethink the way you approach your process for creating concept art. Learn to truly embrace the creative process and create beautiful works of art with uninhibited flow.

In this course, Senior Character Artist Antonio Esparza unveils his full 3D character art pipeline, guiding you from concept to production-ready results. You’ll learn industry techniques for sculpting, texturing, and refining characters used in games, films, and cinematics. Ideal for artists aiming to create high-quality characters, this course covers every essential step in Antonio’s process, equipping you with skills to elevate your portfolio.

Learn professional workflows to design characters for films, games, TV shows, and more from renowned concept designer and illustrator Wouter Gort. Covering everything from the fundamentals of character design, prop development, keyframe illustration, and more, this course covers everything you'll need to know to level up your character workflow.

Create stunning works of art by implementing the powerful language of film. Follow along as concept artist John Sweeney teaches you to create a cinematic image from start to finish. Covering everything from film analysis, to photoshoots, to 2D/3D workflows, this course should prove invaluable for both beginners and experts alike.
Construct realistic environment paintings using both 2D and 3D techniques, and how they apply to a modern video games production pipeline.

Dive into the transformative world of costume design with Adam Middleton, a visionary behind some of cinema's most unforgettable outfits. In this hands-on course, you'll master the art of weaving narrative depth and realistic detail into every aspect of your costume designs. Whether you're a beginner just getting started or a professional refining your skills, Adam's techniques will elevate your costume designs to an expert level of lived-in authenticity. Prepare to unleash your creativity and bring characters to life through the art of grounded costume design.

Sessions are a new, bite-sized series of live workshops presented by Learn Squared, in partnership with some of the leading artists of the entertainment industry. With renowned creatives spanning every corner of the industry from concept illustrators, modelers, VFX artists, and beyond, Learn Squared Sessions are the fastest, most accessible way to learn from the artists behind your favorite content.

items.description: From thumbnail sketch to final render, visionary designer Ash Thorp will show you how to create production-ready UI and data elements for Hollywood films.

Dive into the world of concept art using Unreal Engine 5 with concept artist Ellie Cooper. In this brand new Learn Squared course, Ellie unveils her entire workflow, from initial sketches to finalized portfolio pieces, harnessing UE5's breakthrough tools like Nanite and Lumen. If you're new to Unreal Engine, make sure to check out Ellie's 'Unreal Engine 5 Basics' course, which is designed to help absolute beginners understand the latest toolset. As a special bonus, by purchasing the Concept Art in UE5 course, you'll get Ellie's Unreal Engine 5 Basics course for FREE!

Build hard surface props of any size! Leading concept artist Lars Sowig will guide you through his entire professional workflow, from blocking and modeling to texturing and rendering, all the way down to designing your own stickers and decals. Every movie, TV show and video game needs a prop designer. Why shouldn't that be you?

Under Pablo's guidance, you'll master the use of ZBrush to produce a range of high-quality environment concept art. Learn to create expansive city views, intricate assets, and fully animated scenes, all without relying on any third-party kitbashing. Craft stunningly complex concept designs using a multitude of 3D techniques. Compliment your renders with detailed 2D compositing.

Buckle your seatbelts, secure your belongings, and prepare for takeoff. Elevate your concept art workflows in this brand new course from Pablo Dominguez by learning to generate simple assets in 3D, arranging them to create dynamic compositions, and using them as a base to create beautiful, detailed concept art for your project or portfolio.

Industry-leading art director Patrick O'Keefe will teach you all of his tricks for quickly laying down compelling compositions, zeroing in with detail and color, then post-processing one gorgeous final piece.

Learn cutting edge techniques to create real-time concept art in Unreal Engine 5 from Ellie Cooper. From sculpting hero assets in ZBrush, to assembling a full scene in Unreal Engine 5, all the way through final paintovers and delivery, Ellie will cover her comprehensive process for creating concept art using the industry's latest workflows.

Learn modern concept art techniques from one of the industry's leading artists. AAA video game concept artist Romain Jouandeau will teach you everything you need to know to create a series of dynamic concept art keyframes using Blender and Photoshop in his unique style.

The world is yours. Follow along as renowned concept artist Paul Chadeisson covers his 2D to 3D workflow, including sketching, photobashing, and environment painting, as well as sculpting and rendering realistic environments – everything you need to create a unique world from the ground up.
From loose sketch to realistic rendered illustration, create futuristic character design with consistency and speed. Tackle difficult subject matter with different concepting techniques.

Immerse yourself in the world of video games with AAA concept artist Daniele Solimene. Using a variety of innovative techniques, you’ll learn to work within industry-standard project pipelines and deliver beautiful, game-ready designs. With three adjustable difficulty levels, you can tailor your learning experience to match your skills, and progress at your own pace. If you’ve ever wanted to work in video games, this is your chance to level up your portfolio and come to your next project like a true pro!

Professional concept artist Louis Laurent's completely fluid process will help to unlock entirely new possibilities in your art. Using a mix of 2D and 3D techniques, you'll learn how to harness happy accidents along the way to create beautiful and unique works of art.

A few simple tricks can improve your art in a matter of seconds. Concept artist Steve Wang will teach you to make the most of your sketching, 3D workflows, and digital painting with ease and efficiency. This online course will teach you new and creative ways to hack your workflow, helping you stay focused on creating beautiful artwork.

Create 3D worlds to share with creative directors, tell more dynamic stories, and streamline your creative process. Industry professional Nick Hiatt covers his entire process in Maya, Substance, Redshift, and Photoshop, but the techniques in this training are not software dependent. Learn to use whichever tools you're most familiar with to create unique characters, detailed environments to place them in, and how to arrange everything into a dynamic, cohesive sequence.

Industry-leading art director Patrick O'Keefe will teach you all of his tricks for quickly laying down compelling compositions, zeroing in with detail and color, then post-processing one gorgeous final piece.

Learn modern concept art techniques from one of the industry's leading artists. AAA video game concept artist Romain Jouandeau will teach you everything you need to know to create a series of dynamic concept art keyframes using Blender and Photoshop in his unique style.

The world is yours. Follow along as renowned concept artist Paul Chadeisson covers his 2D to 3D workflow, including sketching, photobashing, and environment painting, as well as sculpting and rendering realistic environments – everything you need to create a unique world from the ground up.
From loose sketch to realistic rendered illustration, create futuristic character design with consistency and speed. Tackle difficult subject matter with different concepting techniques.

items.description: This module covers the fundamental concepts needed to start DIY home automation projects. Learn about the ESP32, set up the Arduino IDE, and take your first steps with the ESP32. You'll work with temperature sensors, optocouplers, relays, and power calculations. Additionally, you'll explore power supplies, troubleshooting techniques, and setting up MQTT servers and brokers. By the end of this course, you'll have a solid foundation to begin your home automation journey.

items.human_name: Arduino Foundations: From Basics to Prototyping
items.description: "Introduction to Arduino and Prototyping" is the perfect starting point for beginners eager to explore the world of Arduino. This course covers the basics of Arduino hardware and software, including the iconic Arduino UNO board and the Arduino IDE. You'll learn to use breadboards, digital and analog pins, and understand hardware communication types like SPI, I2C, and Serial. The course also introduces you to Arduino shields and modules, external power supplies, multimeter basics, and using a protoboard. By the end, you'll have a solid foundation in Arduino and prototyping, ready to bring your

items.human_name: Complete Home Automation: A Full Apartment Example
items.description: This module provides a complete example of an apartment automation project. Learn about automation requirements, explore various modules, and configure the floorplan. You'll design and configure each module, ensuring a seamless and efficient home automation system. By the end of this course, you'll be able to plan, configure, and maintain a comprehensive home automation setup for an entire apartment.

items.human_name: Mastering APIs with Arduino and ESP32
items.description: "Introduction to APIs" teaches you how to integrate powerful APIs with your Arduino projects using the ESP32. You'll learn what APIs are and how to use them, starting with a simple weather API. The course covers serial communication, parsing API responses, and displaying data on an LCD. You'll also explore the ChatGPT API, writing sketches to interact with it from the ESP32, and creating a smart weather assistant. By the end, you'll be adept at integrating APIs with your projects, enhancing their functionality and interactivity.

items.human_name: Tasmota Firmware for Home Automation: A Comprehensive Guide
items.description: This module introduces you to Tasmota, the popular open-source firmware for home automation projects. Learn to install Tasmota, connect and configure various sensors (temperature, humidity, IR, door, light), and work with RGB lights, switches, and actuators. You'll also integrate Sonoff devices seamlessly into your setup. By the end of this course, you'll master Tasmota firmware and be ready to enhance your home automation system.

"Introduction to the Internet of Things" explores the exciting world of IoT using the ESP32 board. You'll learn what IoT is and its primary uses, such as home automation. The course introduces the ESP32, its capabilities, and how to set it up. You'll connect the ESP32 to WiFi, create a web server, control the ESP32 over local WiFi, and use it in access point mode. Additionally, you'll get started with over-the-air updates. By the end, you'll unlock the potential of IoT with the ESP32, ready to create smart home projects.

items.human_name: Weather Watch: Creating a Smart Weather Station with Arduino
items.description: Explore environmental technology with "Weather Watch: Creating a Smart Weather Station with Arduino." Build a device that collects and displays local weather data. You’ll learn about sensor diversity, data processing, and options for data display and web integration, equipping you with the skills to implement real-time weather monitoring.

items.human_name: Solar-Powered Solutions: Building an Arduino Solar Tracker
items.description: Solar-Powered Solutions: Building an Arduino Solar Tracker" is a hands-on course that delves into renewable energy applications. Construct a solar tracker that maximizes energy efficiency using light sensors and motor control. This project enhances understanding of sustainable technology practices while teaching practical electronics and mechanical design.

items.human_name: Arduino Security Engineer: Designing Smart Alarm Systems
items.description: "Arduino Security Engineer: Designing Smart Alarm Systems" teaches you to build customized security solutions using proximity sensors. From simple alarms to automated lighting, learn sensor basics, system integration, and real-world applications. This course is ideal for beginners and offers extensive knowledge applicable in today’s tech-driven world.

items.human_name: Web Interfaces with Arduino: HTML, CSS, and JS4
items.description: "Creating Web Interfaces" teaches you how to build web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and host them on the ESP32. You'll start with an introduction to these web technologies and set up your development environment. The course covers the basics of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and guides you through creating a functional web interface. By the end, you'll have a web interface hosted on the ESP32, enhancing your IoT applications.

items.human_name: Arduino and Processing: Data Visualization and Control
items.description: "Arduino and Processing" introduces you to integrating Arduino with Processing for powerful data visualization and control. You'll start by learning what Processing is and how it complements Arduino. The course covers serial communication between Arduino and Processing, creating a control interface with basic GUI elements, and adding two-way communication. By the end, you'll have a robust system for data visualization and control, ready to enhance your Arduino projects.

items.human_name: Nikola Tesla: The Visionary Who Electrified the World
items.description: Dive into the fascinating life and legacy of Nikola Tesla, one of history's most brilliant minds. This comprehensive course explores Tesla's achievements, inventions, and ideas, from his humble beginnings to his groundbreaking work in electricity, electromagnetism, and wireless communication. You'll learn about the historical context that shaped Tesla's work, his personal challenges, and his revolutionary contributions like alternating current (AC) technology and wireless energy transmission. Discover Tesla's lesser-known innovations and visionary concepts that continue to inspire progress in

items.human_name: Balancing Act: Building a Self-Balancing Robot with Arduino
items.description: Master complex robotics principles in "Balancing Act: Building a Self-Balancing Robot with Arduino." Tackle the challenges of creating a robot that maintains balance with gyroscopes and accelerometers. This advanced course covers sensor fusion, PID control, and real-world robotics applications, perfect for those looking to deepen their robotics expertise.

"Electricity Basics: Understanding the Fundamentals" introduces you to the core concepts of electricity. This section covers atoms, electrons, conductors, current, voltage, power, and Ohm's Law. Learn how to measure these quantities and understand basic circuit analysis, all while emphasizing important safety considerations.

"Circuit Analysis: Techniques and Applications" teaches you the principles and methods for analyzing electronic circuits. This section covers Kirchhoff's Current and Voltage Laws, as well as the behavior of components in series and parallel circuits. Gain practical skills in calculating current flow and voltage drops.

"Component Mastery: Exploring Electronic Elements" provides an in-depth look at the various components that make up electronic circuits. This section covers resistors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, and integrated circuits. Understand their functions and applications within different circuit configurations.

items.human_name: ESP32 Car Control: A Step-by-Step Guide
items.description: "Controlling the Car with the ESP32" integrates the ESP32 into a hardware project to control a car. You'll learn the IoT functionality of the ESP32, connect it to the hardware, and develop a protocol for communication. The course guides you through developing a basic control interface, testing, and improving it for a more intuitive user experience. By the end, you'll have complete control of your car with the ESP32, ready to apply these skills to other projects.

items.human_name: ESP32 AI Assistant and Advanced Controls
items.description: "Introduction to Arduino Programming" is designed for those who want to master coding with Arduino. You'll start by understanding the structure and flow of Arduino programs, including essential functions like setup and loop. The course covers variables, control structures (if statements, loops, switch statements), and data structures like arrays. You'll also learn about built-in functions (delay, pinMode, digitalWrite, analogWrite) and how to write your own. Additionally, the course explores using libraries to expand functionality and guides you on using documentation for further learning. By

items.human_name: Fundamentals of Networking: Connecting the Digital World
items.description: "Fundamentals of Networking: Connecting the Digital World" is a comprehensive course designed to introduce you to the foundational concepts of networking. This course covers essential topics such as network architecture, protocols, IP addressing, and wireless technologies. Whether you're a beginner looking to understand how networks function or an IT enthusiast wanting to deepen your knowledge, this course provides a solid grounding in both theoretical concepts and practical applications. By the end of this course, you'll be equipped with the skills to design, configure, and troubleshoot basic

items.human_name: Arduino for Botanists: Automated Plant Monitoring System
items.description: Learn to automate plant care with "Arduino for Botanists: Automated Plant Monitoring System." This course teaches you to build a system that waters plants, senses environmental conditions, and provides visual feedback to ensure optimal plant health. You’ll learn about sensor integration, automation basics, and data handling, all customizable for expanded functionality.

"Building Your First Arduino Project" takes you through the exciting process of assembling and programming a robot from start to finish. You'll begin with a project overview and proceed to assemble the hardware, including motors, breadboard, Arduino connections, wheels, and an ultrasonic sensor. The course teaches you to control the motors, add remote control capabilities, and enhance the robot with additional sensors. By the end, you'll have a fully functional Arduino robot and the skills to tackle more advanced projects.

items.human_name: Home Automation Hardware Installation: Safe and Effective Practices
items.description: This module covers the essential concepts for installing home automation devices safely and effectively. Learn the basic concepts for US and EU installations, safety considerations, and practical applications. You'll explore new modules, understand installation requirements, and perform maintenance tasks. By the end of this course, you'll be equipped to install and maintain your home automation hardware with confidence.

items.human_name: Fundamentals of Solar Power: Understanding Photovoltaic Systems
items.description: Fundamentals of Solar Power: Understanding Photovoltaic Systems" is an introductory course designed to provide a solid foundation in solar energy technology. Explore the essential concepts of photovoltaic technology, the components of solar power systems, and the basics of system design and installation. This course is perfect for individuals, businesses, and professionals looking to gain a thorough understanding of solar energy without the technical complexities of hands-on practice.

items.human_name: Home Automation Server with Raspberry Pi: Mastering Home Assistant
items.description: This module teaches you how to set up and configure a home automation server using Raspberry Pi and Home Assistant. Learn the basics of Raspberry Pi, install Home Assistant, and configure the main dashboard and zones. You'll create your first automation and integrate various devices, using Home Assistant documentation to guide you. By the end of this course, you'll be able to monitor and control your DIY devices effortlessly.

items.human_name: Hands-On Electronics: Practical Projects and Applications
items.description: "Hands-On Electronics: Practical Projects and Applications" offers hands-on experience through practical projects. Apply your theoretical knowledge by building circuits such as an LED flasher, light sensor night light, and more. This section emphasizes the application of learned concepts to real-world projects.

items.description: Lock-picking - Key locks, Padlocks, and Ciphers brings Skyrim style lock-picking to Unity! This package features three lock types: Keyhole, Padlock, and a Cipher lock, as well as a button. The keyhole and button come with two baseplates which can be used together, or not at all, for four different baseplate options. There are three styles of key holes as well, to add variety to your project. Overlay the lockset like they do in Skyrim, or even embed the locks into a door, wall, or treasure chest. The cipher lock can be modified with the Substance Painter source files so you can create your own

Wardrobe is modular, so you can turn it on/off as well, and blend shapes allow for mesh morphing so you can randomize things even more. * Unity & Unral * Substance Painter files * Mesh Morphing * Animation Rig

They range from cheaper wooden box-type chests to ornate, fancy, gold filled chests. Each one has it's own pre-made look, but can have it's metal & wood materials be changed using a huge variety of metals and woods. 5 Pre-exported texture sets are included. The pack includes customizable gold & gem piles, and the Mimic character comes with full animations & blend shapes for mesh customization. Perfect for that dungeon you're build

Payments to World Land Trust are made via the  PayPal Giving Fund . The World Land Trust (WLT) is an international conservation charity, which protects the world's most biologically important and threatened habitats acre by acre. Since its foundation in 1989 (as the World Wide Land Conservation Trust), the WLT has funded partner organizations around the world to create reserves, and give permanent protection to habitat and their wildlife. World Land Trust is a registered charity in the UK, number 1001291.

Plant Monster Pack PBR is a fanciful character perfect for Fantasy & RPG games. The animations are fluid and realistic, and the customization options are spectacular. Beyond customizing every aspect of the texture, you can create many "levels" of Plant Monster by turning off some of the sub-meshes, like the leaves, thorns, flowers or vines. * Unity & Unreal * Music * Sound Effects * Concept Art * Substance Painter files * Mesh Morphing

This package contains rings, gems, rivets, bracers, amulets & more. Most objects can be morphed using blend shapes, to better fit whatever character they're attached to. It's easy to add gems to rings and customize the look and feel. While these look great from far away, 4k textures allow them to be inspected close up. * Unity & Unreal * Mesh Morphing * Substance Painter files

The Devils Pack is a monster of a package. It features 3 body designs, 3 unique heads & 4 horn options, including the option of no horns at all. The wardrobe set is large, with many ways of customizing the selection to create a vast array of Devil characters. Devils also comes with two custom Swords. * Unity & Unreal * Substance Painter files * Mesh Morphing * Concept Art * Animation Rig * Music * Sound Effects

Rock Monster PBR Pack is a giant 9 foot tall magical rock character. He features a custom made default texture along with a handful of other rock textures to choose from, as well as the ability to use a custom texture you may already have. Fully animated with realistic physics & featuring a bunch of particle effects to use or modify, this is one giant creature your game needs. * Unity & Unreal * Music * Sound Effects * Concept Art and Mesh Morphing

Spiders Pack features three fully animated Spider characters. Resize in editor to create Small, Medium & Large spiders -- each one is designed to be different enough from the others so players know they're unique. * Unity & Unreal * Substance Painter files * Concept Art * Music * Sound effects

Magic & Melee Customizable Sound Library has been designed with customization and randomization in mind. Mix and match the component sounds, and you can have thousands of unique sounds. Combine clips randomly at runtime, or export them with a single click and select your favorite combinations. Magic Air, Earth, Electric, Evil/Dark, Fire, Holy/Light, Ice, Poison, and Water magic includes multiple explosions, hits, warmups both long and short. Combine these with generic buffs, hums and pulses, spell fizzles and fails, and more to create a huge array of magic sounds to that fit your spells. M

Minotaur comes with a giant two-handed axe and a set of light armor. The armor and axe each have four ready-to-use texture sets, and there are 6 skins ready to go for the body. All textures come with Substance Painter source files for massive texture customization. Blend shapes add even more to the pack, giving you the ability to customize the look of your creatures, or randomize them at run time. * Unity & Unreal *  Substance Painter files * Animation Rig * Mesh Morphing

This versatile Demons package comes with three head designs, three horn types, with the ability to mix and match for even more variety, plus a modular armor set with multiple textures, ready to drop in your game. * Unity (Unreal coming soon) * Concept Art * Substance Painter files * Music * Sound Effects * Mesh Morphing

Dragons Pack PBR is a highly detailed package containing three distinct dragon heads, four back options, two tails. Tons of animations bring the dragons to life, both on land and in the air. Also comes with a saddle, reins & bridle. Mesh morphing allows for each head and the entire body to be morphed for infinite looks and in-game randomization. * Unity & Unreal * Mesh Morphing * Substance Painter files * Concept Art * Music * Sound Effects * Animation Rig

Weapons & Armor Pack #1 has 30 Weapons & Armor pieces, and every object has a default look, and most have mesh morphing and Substance Painter source files for customizing the textures. * Unity & Unreal * Concept Art * Substance Painter files * Mesh Morphing

Our human character pack is a highly detailed package containing male & female base bodies with extensive mesh morphing for facial and body customization & randomization. Five wardrobe texture sets are included ready to be used in game. Body textures are presented in 4k, along with the Substance Painter source files, so you can customize it even more. Tons of animations bring the characters to life, with details down to the movement of the clothing & hair. A huge amount of modular wardrobe options. Works with wardrobe from the Elf & Half-Orc packs from our series. * Unity &

Armor Pack 1 contains 20 unique textures from 5 very different armor models. Each one is modular, with many individual parts that can be turned on or off to create dozens of different looks. Mesh Morphing increases the versatility of the wardrobe, and all of the armor works with the Human character pack. * Unity & Unreal * Mesh Morphing * Substance painter files

The Medusa Character Pack features two individual Medusa models. One has a Serpentine tail, while the other is fully human...aside from the snakes on her head. Masterfully rigged and animated, this pack will surely strike terror in your players. * Unity (Unreal coming soon) * Music * Sound Effects * Mesh Morphing * Animation Rig * Substance Painter files * Concept Art

Mushroom Monster PBR is a 2 Meter tall creature. He can be in any one of three static poses, waiting to surprise his opponent, or he can run around attacking and casting spells and even charging. He bashes his enemies with his head, can jump at them to bash them or run straight, head down. He also has a ""magic"" attack, twisting and slicing his head. Use the Blend Shapes feature to morph the mesh into countless looks for massive customization. * Unity & Unreal * Music * Sound Effects * Concept Art * Mesh Morphing

Giant Worm PBR is no joke. It defaults to 24 feet long, and in the idle position stands 15 feet from the ground to the top most position. Its mouth sits 2 meters from the ground, ready to chomp on an enemies head. The attacks are strong and the worm can spray poison from its mouth and he can appear and disappear from his hiding spot under the ground. * Unity & Unreal * Mesh Morphing * Concept Art * Animation Rig * Music * Sound Effects

Sighs, scoffs, gasps, groans, short laughs, and the kind of scream that happens before anyone can think. Real reactions, zero filter. Perfect for games, animations, and any project that needs young characters to actually sound their age.

Toe-tapping acoustic pop, bouncy indie folk, and tropical house that makes you want to dance around the kitchen. Handclaps, whistling, ukulele, and glockenspiel. Skipping through the park. Rolling down the highway with the windows open. Good friends, lazy afternoons, and that burst of joy when everything just clicks. Weekend content, summer reels, feel-good commercials, and creators spreading smiles.

Symphonic Majestic is a collection of history's most powerful compositions, from Mozart's soaring arias and Vivaldi's exultant concertos to Tchaikovsky's sweeping romanticism. This is the definitive source for unparalleled elegance, heroic fanfares, and profound emotional depth. Convey greatness.

This is a pack of 31 uplifting electronic tracks built for content that needs energy, optimism, and a sun-soaked vibe. From breezy tropical house and future bass to deep house grooves and urban electro, every track is designed to motivate, elevate, and keep things moving. Perfect for travel videos, fitness content, commercials, and anything that deserves a feel-good soundtrack.

Bouncy. Bright. Pure, unfiltered happiness. Ukuleles and handclaps. Pizzicato strings and jingle bells. Wobbly trombones and sparkly music boxes. Toe-tapping indie folk, silly reggae pop, and lullabies that whisper "sleep tight." This collection is a playground of sound—carefree, whimsical, and bursting with giggles. Nap time. Playtime. Anytime little ones need a smile. No grown-up stuffiness. Just joy.

Error tones, digital distortions, 8-bit malfunctions, sensor static, power hum failures, and processing glitches — every frequency here signals something going wrong in exactly the right way. Whether you're building a corrupted UI, a hacked interface, or a world where the code is falling apart, this pack has the sonic fingerprint of a system in collapse.

Retro Transmission is 20 sounds from the golden age of broadcasting — vintage radios switching on, analog dials tuning across bands, ham radio operators, TV static, dead channels, channel surfing, and rotary dial clicks. From a 1938 Stromberg console to a flickering CRT screen, this pack captures the warm, crackling imperfection of an era when signals had to be found

African lakeshores, Amazon jungles, desert nights, medieval caves, and open skies. Lions, horses, vintage aircraft, jungle wildlife, and thunderstorms sit alongside foley footsteps, boat engines, and cinematic stingers. Everything you need to make a world feel real and alive.

Unleash raw, cinematic power. This pack of explosive tracks is your ultimate weapon for high-octane storytelling, blending skull-crushing metal, driving orchestral action, and gritty rock anthems to fuel everything from epic sports highlights and brutal trailers to intense gameplay and investigative thrillers. Command the energy. Dominate the scene.

Cosmic Horror Tech – a playlist of glitched-out dread. Features cosmic swells, void rumbles, and digital malfunctions. Soundtrack your alien signal from the void, corrupted AI, or tech overwhelmed by something ancient.

From precision pipe bomb blasts and black powder charges to battlefield artillery, car explosions, meteor impacts, and sci-fi detonations — every layer, every rumble, and every shockwave is here. When your scene calls for the moment everything changes, this pack delivers the sound that makes audiences feel it in their chest.
A diverse collection of cosmic drones, futuristic technology, space effects, atmospheric textures, and otherworldly ambiences for sci-fi, fantasy, games, and cinematic productions.

human_name: Humble Software Bundle: Ultimate Unity Fantasy RPG Developer

When you’re ready to get started, jump right into creation with a versatile range of 3D assets tailor-made for RPGs—fully rigged fantasy characters, high-quality monsters, dungeon sets, and more. Plus, your purchase will support National Network of Abortion Funds and NARAL Pro-Choice America Foundation! Pay €1 or more. Normally, the total cost for the software in this bundle is as much as US$2,138. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum €1 purchase. Redeem your keys.  Get all the amazing content in this bundle by simply redeeming a set of product keys through any internet browser. Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the developer, National Network of Abortion Funds, and  NARAL Pro-Choice America Foundation via PayPal Giving Fund . If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too! Equip yourself with the knowledge & tools you need to develop epic games using Unity with this bundle of courses & RPG assets! Build a well-rounded foundation with multi-part instructional courses that teach you how to master making games in Unity. When you’re ready to get started, jump right into creation with a versatile range of 3D assets tailor-made for RPGs—fully rigged fantasy characters, high-quality monsters, dungeon sets, and more. Plus, your purchase will support National Network of Abortion Funds and NARAL Pro-Choice America Foundation!

items.description: This low poly version of the Demons character includes a whole range of animations and our own colour shifter tool allowing you to create endless combinations and variety. They're ready to leap into action from the darkest corners of your dungeons. Works seamlessly with environments from Synty studios.

The Devils pack brings 3 unique heads, multiple body options, and a modular wardrobe along with mesh morphing and texture variants to create as many devils as you can think of and fill your world with variety and life. Or death. Fully animated with included music and sound effects make them ready to use in your world. From a safe distance.

items.human_name: Serpent Warrior - Snake RPG Character Pack
items.description: The Serpent Warrior is ready to slither into battle with its devastating claws and powerful magic arsenal. Including mesh morphing, texture variations, and animations ready to drop into your world. And the included sound effects and music included provide everything you need to terrify heroes>

Armour Pack 2 contains a range of high quality, modular full body armour rigged to our Half orc, Human and Elf Packs. All armour packs are cross compatible and can be used to mix and match with the other armour packs.

items.human_name: GameDev Mastery Course, Part 1 - "2D Side Scroller"
items.description: Learn the fundamentals of game development and C# programming while building a 2D platformer game. Discover animation, physics, scripting, & AI while you customize your game and and deploy to web, pc, or mobile.

Our Dragon pack includes 3 distinct heads to choose from, along with multiple backs and tail options to customise and make these dragons your own. Fits perfectly as a companion to our Dragons 2 pack. Included mesh morphing and colour variants complete the range and enable you to build the dragons you want. Included music and sound effects make the Dragons pack ready to use and set your world alight.

This low poly version of the Skeleton Warrior pack includes a range of animations and our own colour shifter tool to allow you to create endless colour combinations and variety. There's an army of skeletons waiting on your commands. Our low poly characters work seamlessly with environments from Synty Studios.

This aMAZEing Minotaur pack includes a full range of mesh morphing, modular wardrobe, and optional body parts to customise and create endless variety. With animations included, this pack has the Minotaur ready to drop into your maze and protect your treasures.

The flying eye comes with everything you need to attack from above. Built in mesh morphing and texture variants let you create a huge range of options and variety. And the included sound effects and music will have you up and running in no time. Your heroes will never SEE them coming.
Dragons with a younger look, matching our first Dragons pack, to give more variety or growth potential. Comes with music and more!

Character Portraits 8 brings over 1300 AI-generated character portraits to the table in 10 distinct styles. Hours of work go into creating a huge range of variety in the style you need to drop into your prototype or ready-to-ship title.

This high quality slime character has silently arrived to enter your world and take your heroes by storm. Texture variants are included to allow you to create a range of different slimes, and the bundled music will have them invading your ears too.

items.human_name: Half-Orc RPG Character (Human, Elf, Male, Female)
items.description: A pack of fully rigged Half Orcs (male and female models included) with their own modular wardrobe, sound effects, animations and built in mesh morphs to kick-start your player and enemy customisation. Works to create both humans and elves (and more) with mesh morphing.

This low poly version of the Mushroom Monster pack includes a range of animations and our own colour shifter tool to allow you to create endless colour combinations. These mushroom monsters will really grow on you. Our low poly characters work seamlessly with environments from Synty Studios.
Use the GameModules pack from InfinityPBR to build a game. Learn how the Stats, Conditions, and Inventory system work in practice and how you can use them for your own games.

items.human_name: Re-mixable Battle Sound Library - Magic & Melee
items.description: Create completely unique audio or randomize and mix clips together to creating dynamic and exciting audio. With sounds for both physical weapons and magical sounds recorded by a foley artist, this pack has everything you need to bring your world to life.

Take your gamedev skills to the next level and build a First/Third person shooter. In addition to the core FPS features, we'll also learn how to add timelines, cinematics, and more advanced camera controls.

This low poly version of the Bats pack includes a range of animations and our own colour shifter tool to allow you to create endless colour combinations and variety. Get your heroes looking up as your bats take over the ceilings! Our low poly characters work seamlessly with environments from Synty Studios.

This low poly version of the Gargoyles pack includes a range of animations and our own colour shifter tool to allow you to create endless colour combinations. The included mesh morphs add additional variety. Our low poly characters work seamlessly with environments from Synty Studios.

Our Gargoyles pack includes multiple texture variants and mesh morphing to customise and tailor to meet your needs. The included animations, sound effects and music has everything you need to get going. Drop them off the ballistrades and get your Gargoyles ready to attack today.

This high-quality Scorpion character is ready to plunge into your heroes' hearts and into yours. Built-in mesh morphing and multiple texture sets let you create a huge range of variety in your monsters to fill your world and make it your own. Included Substance Painter source files put you in control of even more.

This low poly version of the Bomber Bug pack includes a range of animations and our own colour shifter tool to allow you to create endless colour combinations. These guys are a blast. Our low poly characters work seamlessly with environments from Synty Studios.

Learn expert techniques in lighting, foliage, and VFX to create a professional-quality fantasy river scene.

By the end, you'll have the skills to create customizable, non-destructive 3D structures for your projects.

items.description: Create procedural mazes using Unity techniques and design modular assets in Blender. items.description: Gain practical skills in procedural material creation using Blender 4.4. Explore shader logic, node setups, and real-world textures across a project-based learning path for aspiring 3D artists.

items.human_name: Blender and Python Scripting - A Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
items.description: Unlock Blender's full potential by learning how to script with Python. This beginner-focused course takes you from Python basics to creating complex 3D object automation in Blender. No prior coding or 3D experience required—just curiosity and commitment.

Design and automate weapon creation workflows using Blender 4.4. This course teaches procedural modeling, geometry nodes, and Python scripting to build export-ready assets. Ideal for 3D artists aiming to level up with automation and generative design.

items.description: Dive into procedural modeling with Blender 4’s Geometry Nodes as you create intricate jungle vines from scratch. Learn to control curves, set up random spawn points, refine mesh parameters, apply textures, and animate your creations with precision. By the end, you'll have a fully customizable vine system ready for dynamic 3D environments.

items.human_name: Blender Geometry Nodes for Beginners - Procedural Bridge Generator
items.description: Unlock the potential of procedural modeling in Blender with this beginner-friendly course on Geometry Nodes. Learn to design and shape curve-based bridges, add intricate stone paths, and master essential node workflows. By the end, you’ll have the skills to create customizable, non-destructive 3D structures for your projects.

items.human_name: Master Inventory System Creation - Unity 6 & Blender Fundamentals
items.description: Create an advanced inventory system in Unity using C# and UI elements while integrating custom 3D assets from Blender. Learn item management, interactive UI design, and real-world game development workflows.

Begin your Blender journey with this comprehensive foundation course tailored for version 4.4. Learn essential tools, workflows, and best practices across modeling, materials, lighting, and rendering. Perfect for newcomers aiming to build professional 3D skills from the ground up.

items.description: Create a fully functional Tower Defense game with Unity and Blender. This course covers AI mechanics, pathfinding, turret placement, UI design, and 3D asset creation. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, you'll gain essential skills to build an immersive and engaging strategy game.

items.description: Learn 3D environment creation in Blender 4 with a focus on Victorian-style scenes. This course covers modeling, texturing, and rendering, from architecture to intricate props. By the end, you'll create a photorealistic urban setting ready for high-quality renders.

items.description: Explore the process of creating a boat model in Blender using Geometry Nodes. From understanding lofting techniques to adding intricate details like supports, timber borders, and seats, this course offers a comprehensive approach. By the end, you'll have the skills to craft realistic boats with advanced node-based workflows.

items.description: Learn how to create intricate, procedural 3D trees using Blender's Geometry Nodes. This course guides you through every detail, from base generation to falling leaf effects. By the end, you'll master a fully node-driven approach to nature modeling.

Whether you’re crafting stylized buildings, realistic terrains, or intricate props, you'll gain the skills to create visually rich, optimized scenes.

Discover how to design game environments, import assets into Unity and Unreal Engine, and publish your own character-based game. Gain practical skills that empower you to bring your game development vision to life.

Build detailed architectural structures, optimize workflows, and create professional-quality 3D environments with industry-leading tools and techniques.

By the end, you’ll be able to create stunning, game-ready environments with professional-quality assets and textures.

items.description: Explore the cosmos with 'Space Scene Essentials' for Unreal Engine 5.3. "Space Station" sets a new standard for sci-fi realism in Unreal Engine 5.3. Orbit a massive, detailed planet, navigating through asteroid fields and dust clouds. The central feature is a sprawling space station, meticulously designed to accommodate a variety of habitats and vessels. This project is a perfect canvas for creators looking to construct a bustling hub of interstellar activity and envision the future of space habitation.

"Planet Destruction" plunges you into a somber cosmic spectacle within Unreal Engine 5.3. Witness a planet shattered to pieces, its debris caught in a haunting orbital dance. The exposed core seethes with Niagara particle streams, embodying the raw chaos of a celestial demise. Leveraging Virtual Textures, the project boasts ultra-high-definition textures, making for an intense and moody space scene ripe for exploration and storytelling.

Harness the power of procedural generation with "Nebula Generator," a bridge between Blender and Unreal Engine 5.3. This project empowers users to create bespoke volumetric nebulas in Blender and seamlessly export them as skyboxes for Unreal Engine, offering an infinite canvas for celestial artistry. It's the ultimate tool for crafting expansive, personalized space environments with ease.

"Volumetric Nebulas" transforms your Unreal Engine 5.3 projects with 3D, volumetric cosmic clouds. This tool lets you craft detailed nebulas, infusing your space scenes with unparalleled depth and aesthetics. The versatile blueprint enables multiple configurations, with complete control over color, opacity, and density—ideal for elevating space environments to stellar new heights.

"Procedural Planet Worlds" unlocks the power of creation in Unreal Engine 5.3, offering the tools to generate a diverse array of procedural planets. Accompanied by an asteroid ring and a noise-based cloud system, it provides extraordinary flexibility and crisp, high-resolution textures. Perfect for those who seek to populate their universe with unique, detailed worlds at the click of a button.

Embark on an epic sci-fi journey with "Sun Harvest," a visionary Unreal Engine 5.3 project. Centered around a colossal Dyson Sphere, this asset captures the grandeur of harvesting a star's energy. The energy extracted pulsates towards a neighboring planet, setting the scene for magnificent backdrops and grandiose scale storytelling. This environment is crafted for creators who aim to push the boundaries of sci-fi visuals and narrative.

"Planet Collapse" offers a dramatic tableau for Unreal Engine 5.3 users, featuring a high-definition planet marred by a gaping crater. With Niagara particle effects spewing from the chasm, the scene sets the stage for atmospheric and narrative-rich development. It's a fertile ground for creators to build upon, ensuring every space story told is visually gripping and immersive.

Elevate your space scenes with "Skybox Collection," a compilation of 16k resolution skyboxes tailored for Unreal Engine 5.3, offering unprecedented detail and depth. Designed for cinematic scale, these skyboxes feature expansive nebulas and intricate solar systems, providing an instant upgrade to the visual majesty of any project, perfect for creators aiming for epic grandeur in their celestial designs.

Craft cosmic chaos with 'Asteroid Field' for Unreal Engine 5.3. This project lets you wield advanced physics to set asteroids in motion around an orbit, or shape them into various formations. Enhanced with a blueprint system and cutting-edge volumetrics, it's perfect for forging breathtaking scenes. At its heart lies a shattered planet core, adding a dramatic edge to your space vistas.

Step into the gravitational pull with "Blackhole Dynamics" for Unreal Engine 5.3, a real-time black hole simulation crafted with HLSL. Easily integrate this effect into any scene to warp and distort the fabric of your virtual space. The customizable blueprint lets you adjust size, shape, and color, offering complete control over the singularity's appearance. It's a powerful tool for developers and artists aiming to add a scientifically-inspired spectacle to their creations.

"Advanced Volumetric Blackhole" is a cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5.3 project that simulates the life cycle of a massive star transforming into a black hole. Experience a colossal gravitational field that bends the very skybox around it, mimicking the distortion of space-time. At its heart, a volumetric accretion disk revolves, defining the event horizon. This project is ideal for creators seeking to add a scientifically grounded, yet visually stunning phenomenon to their space scenes.

items.human_name: Becoming a More Valuable UX Professional
items.description: Do you ever feel like your ideas don't have influence or that you don't have control over the direction of a project? In this course, Becoming a More Valuable UX Professional, you'll learn soft skills that will help you bring strategic thinking into your work, and thereby increase your value and the overall value of UX as a discipline. First, you'll explore how to approach your work strategically. Next, you'll discover the requirements for gathering the necessary tools. Finally, you'll dive into speaking the language of business, so you can gain more credibility when speaking with stakeholders

At the core of interaction design are a thorough knowledge of psychology and the ability to anticipate and build around users' needs. In this course, Psychology of Interaction Design, you will learn many of the psychological principles used today to create engaging and intuitive applications. First, you will learn the 5 core pillars of interaction design. Next, you will discover many of the popular psychological methods your favorites apps and sites are using today. Finally, you will explore how to understand the brain's cyclical pattern before and after every single interaction. When you're f

We all want to create “intuitive” and “delightful” experiences. These are easy words to say, but actually shipping a product that is intuitive and delightful is very difficult to accomplish. In this course you will learn when to do UX Research and how UX Research fits into the product development timeline. We’ll also cover UX Research techniques, and when is the best time to do each technique. Along the way, together we will conduct research on a hypothetical app using easy, common-sense techniques that anyone can do.

items.human_name: Hacking the User Experience / UX for Developers
items.description: Understanding User Experience (UX) and how to improve it is a key skill for any modern developer. Unfortunately, many developers have a difficult time embracing UX due to its nebulous and design-focused nature. This course will give you a super-simple, crystal-clear understanding of UX and will teach you how to incrementally improve it by hacking your users' brains. In the end, you will have the knowledge necessary to make you a better developer, and make you much more valuable in this new age of user experience.

items.human_name: User Experience Tips and Tricks for Developers
items.description: "User experience" has become a buzzword in recent years, and users and companies are expecting more and more from their software. As a developer, you need to stay ahead of this trend by understanding and applying basic UX principles and best practices. This course will show you ten practical tips that you can start using today to improve the user experience of your software.

Ever wonder why somethings are fun to use and some are almost painful? Ever wonder if you could have done a better job designing that thing? If so, Getting Started in UX Design was made for you. First, you'll learn about what User Experience designers actually do. Next, you'll follow that up with a simple process you can apply to any UX problem and then look at some of the tools you can use in that process. Finally, you'll discover some practical tips for how you can get started in the field. When you're finished with this course, you'll know how to identify and approach UX problems, and most

If you’re not testing, you’re guessing. Maybe you’ll guess right, but with thousands and sometimes millions of dollars on the line, taking that kind of bet may not the best option. Prototyping is one of the fastest, easiest methods to test your ideas, validate assumptions and avoid taking a financial loss. In this course, Prototyping Techniques for UX Design, you’ll look at the benefits of prototyping, and take you through the creation process step by step. This course's stance on software design is that starting from the ideal UX leads to a task-oriented analysis and top-down design of the solution. Not surprisingly, this is the exact opposite of the approach that has been taken for decades and that now is often giving more pain than gain. In this course, UX-driven Software Design, you'll learn a new way to design software. First, you'll discover the evidence of what makes software development an unpredictable science. Next, you'll explore how to turn requirements into visual artifacts for customers. Then, you'll cover abstract visual artifacts

Then, you will explore why the company philosophy matters, and how it affects experience design. Finally, you'll learn UX practices, and you will learn about the entire Experience Organization within a company. First, you'll uncover quick and easy user research techniques that will help in understanding users and their goals. Alternatively, is it how it makes you feel and the meaning that it brings within the context of your day-to-day? items.human_name: Creating User Experiences: Fundamental Design Principles
items.description: We're in a new era of software and devices, and user expectations are rising rapidly. To meet those expectations, developers need to understand more about design concepts. Whether working alone, or with a designer, this course will help by explaining fundamental principles, concepts, and terminology, and by exposing developers to a broad range of design possibilities.

In recent years, there's been a shift in how and why software is being developed, moving away from "it works" and moving towards "it works and it's enjoyable to use." The user is now at the center of the software being built, and user experience, or UX, is everything. But what exactly does that mean? How do you design, build, test and quantify an experience for your users? In this course, User Experience: The Big Picture, you'll learn the core concepts of UX and how it fits within the context of software development. Along the way, you'll explore basic terminology, processes, and tools used to

The task to implement a UX design system requires a cohesive, collaborative process across many different stakeholders. First, you’ll explore the purpose of wireframing in the UX design process. Next, you’ll delve into different types of wireframes, what fidelity is, and how to decide what type of wireframe to create.
